1.plot: After he's laid off, a desperate salaryman finds refuge in slumber. But after weeks pass and he doesn't wake up, his son asks Kitaro for help.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Zunbera Spirit Surgery
1.plot: Kirara hates how her schoolmates stare at her homely face. The witch-like yokai Zunbera offers to make her beautiful, but her help doesn't come cheap.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - The Mystery of the Tide! Umizatō
1.plot: Mana heads to Sakaiminato and can't wait to attend the local festival. But things go awry when a boat goes missing along with her uncle.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Kani-Bōzu and the Ancient Mystery
1.plot: A monk-like yokai challenges those he meets to answer his question and turns those who cannot into stone. Mana and Kitaro's father must save the day.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Kawauso's Lie
1.plot: Car Girl takes pity on a hungry boy and secretly gives him some of the vegetables she's been growning. But there's something strange about him.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Ressurected Yōkai?! The Obake School
1.plot: Kitaro sneaks into a ghost school that's attracting the attention and attendance of local kids. It seems like a great place but something's off.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Memories of the Yōka
1.plot: Mana visits her sick great aunt. When she shows Kitaro the red flower that blooms in her garden, he suspects something supernatural and heads south.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Flame on! The Solitude of the Takurō-Bi
1.plot: Rat Man's up to no good again, this time using a fire yokai to power his amusement park attraction. It soon forms an unlikely friendship with a robot.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Berserk!! The Terrifying Yōkai Gyūki
1.plot: Kitaro and his friends visit an island where legends tell of an ox demon. There, a television crew coordinated by Rat Man soon sparks a crisis.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - The Yōkai Apartment Secret Story
1.plot: Natsumi is ready to close down her grandparents' old apartment building when Kitaro appears and asks her to reconsider, telling her about its history.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Nezumi-Otoko's Disappearance?! Sekiyō's Trap
1.plot: Rat Man gets married but his beautiful bride quickly takes advantage of him. She's actually a gold-digging yokai and surprisingly tough to stop.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E25 - Kubire-Oni's Curse
1.plot: Mana installs a pernicious smartphone app that curses the person she names. But the unhappiness she causes soon multiplies, and rebounds back to her.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E26 - Glamour! The Beautiful Gahi
1.plot: Yuna's mother forbids her to talk to boys. But when she finds a magic picture of a beautiful young man, he comes alive and becomes her companion.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E27 - Invasion! Backbeard's Army
1.plot: Kitaro and friends accept a number of refugee yokai but cultural differences quickly lead to trouble. The true enemy waits behind the scenes.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E28 - The Great Yōkai War
1.plot: As the nefarious Backbeard's minions prepare another assault on the Japanese yokai world, Kitaro attempts to destroy the Ring of Arcana.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E29 - The Insane Frankenstein
1.plot: While looking for the ring, Agnes causes trouble downtown and earns a scolding from Kitaro. But she soon gets a very different reception from Mana.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E30 - The Vampire's Halloween Party
1.plot: Halloween fever hits Japan but Cat Girl isn't feeling the love. She heads to the movies with Mana, where Carmilla and some vampiric minions await.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E31 - Azuki-Arai, Azuki-Hakari, Azuki-Babaa
1.plot: The azuki bean yokai trio is bummed because humans don't fear them anymore. Rat Man offers to fix all their problems and make azuki beans great again.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E32 - Akuma Belial: The Hundred-Year Grudge
1.plot: Mana runs into Kojiro, who still has feelings for her. While trying to look cool he accidentally breaks a sphere, unsealing the demon Belial's power.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E33 - The Fox's Wedding and Hakusanbō
1.plot: Kitaro meets a wealthy man whose daughter faces kidnapping by a yokai. Meanwhile, Kitaro's foes find a lead in their search for the Ring of Arcana.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E34 - Emperor Blackbeard
1.plot: Kitaro's friends usually take an annual vacation together, but this year's trip is cancelled when members of the group begin to disappear one-by-one.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E35 - The Witches of Destiny
1.plot: Fearful of attracting harm to her Japanese friends from Backbeard, Agnes says farewell. But Mana's won't let go of their relationship so easily.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E36 - The Transform All Japanese Yokai Project
1.plot: Adele and Agnes race to see who will find the ring first but it winds up on Mana's finger, sticking her in the center of a dramatic magical battle.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E37 - Decisive Battle!! Backbeard
1.plot: One human who survives Backbeard's Brigadoon accepts the help of a former foe and must risk everything to save Kitaro and the rest of humanity.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E38 - New Year's Cannibal Mystery Kasha
1.plot: After a long hiatus, a corpse-stealing yokai is again spotted trying to bring a body home to eat. Weak with age, he must try new tactics to succeed.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E39 - Yuki-Onna Snow White Love Report
1.plot: Feverishly in love, Shun confesses his feelings for Yuki-Onna. The two start dating, but it all goes sour after Shun seeks love advice from Rat Man.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E40 - The Final Ballad: Sara-Kozō
1.plot: Entertainer Bimbo Isamu decides to deal with his faded career by risking the wrath of the yokai Sara Kozo and stealing his signature chant.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E41 - Enigma! Bake-Zōri's Rebellion
1.plot: After their owner moves away, the yokai-possessed belongings he left behind get very upset. Rat Man manipulates the situation to his advantage.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E42 - Momon-Jii's Scheme: The Great Yōkai Trial
1.plot: The tengu arrest Kitaro for an arcane yokai crime. There's a mountain of evidence against him, so much that his friends suspect the trial's a set-up.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E43 - Eternal Life: Odoro-Odoro
1.plot: While investigating a series of vampiric incidents, Kitaro receives a letter from a scientist who claims to have found the secret to immortality.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E44 - Masquerade Nopperabō
1.plot: Aspiring celebrity Atsushi struggles to maintain his playboy act since he's actually a nerd. He gets support from a mysterious online friend.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E45 - The Truth Lies in the Thicket of the Mannen-Dake
1.plot: Kitaro and his friends head into a bamboo thicket infamous for a yokai that supposedly leads those who enter astray. A chilling greeting awaits them.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E46 - The Cursed Doll Festival Mayuge
EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E47 - The Baby-Stealing Ubume
EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E48 - The Void of Despair and Darkness
EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E49 - Nanashi And Mana
EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E50 - Messenger From the Underworld Nue
1.plot: Kitaro heads to a village where people are suffering from an unknown ailment. Cat Girl insists on accompanying him but she's still not back to normal.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E51 - Enma-Diao's Secret Bargain
1.plot: Giant Nue appears above Tokyo, menacing the city and causing chaos. Kitaro heads down to Hell to strike an ambitious deal with King Enma.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E52 - Runaway Girl! The Forest of the Kinoko
1.plot: Mana's friend Miyabi wishes she didn't have to study or do chores. She soon meets the 'Tree Children,' who give her more than she bargained for.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E53 - Narcissism Overload! Nuke-Kubi's Close Call!
1.plot: Vlogger Charatomi's frustration with job interviews leads him to pair up with insecure yokai Nukekubi. But their plan sparks an unfortunate reaction.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E54 - Dorotabo, life and Earth
1.plot: A tormented farmer's spirit takes the monstrous form of a giant yokai nightly. Kitaro recognizes it as the same yokai from an incident 30 years ago.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E55 - Hihi's Harassment Hell
1.plot: Tennis playing yokai Hihi wants to train a human to win the gold medal. His training methods are effective but extreme, forcing Kitaro to intervene.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E56 - The Bewitching Melody Elite the Vampire
1.plot: Frustrated after Kitaro rejects his avaricious nature, Rat Man finds a vampiric companion who appreciates his material desires and wants his help.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E57 - The Bloody Noble La Siene
1.plot: Agnes informs Kitaro that recent blood-sucking incidents don't just involve vampires; they're connected to the resurgence of their old foe, Backbeard.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E58 - The Han-Gyojin's Strange Kamaboko Tale
1.plot: While investigating ship-related incidents, Kitaro runs into the ever-mercurial Rat Man, who leads him right into the clutches of a familiar foe.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E59 - Promise to The Female Yokai Ushirogami
1.plot: After receiving a disturbing message, Mana goes to check on a friend but finds her missing. A mysterious cactus seems to be connected to the incident.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E60 - Pitch-Black Coldness The Yokai Buru-Buru
1.plot: Mana, Yuta, Hiroto, and Soma head out camping. The older boys tease Yuta for being a scaredy-cat, but a sudden chill soon has them all spooked.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E61 - Tofu-Kozo's Mold Pandemic
1.plot: Despondent singer Kana Nickel meets a tofu-carrying yokai. After she discovers that, like her, he lacks a sense of purpose, she makes him her manager.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E62 - The Four Generals of the Underworld Kurobozu's Trap
1.plot: Panic ensues after polluted water appears at the site of a newly constructed dam. Kitaro suspects it's the work of the powerful yokai Kurobozu.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E63 - The Star Festival of Love The Yokai Flower
1.plot: Rat Man asks Kitaro for help with Seika, a yokai who uses bamboo to harass humans. Kitaro soon discovers there's another side to Seika's actions.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E64 - The Heart's Darkness the Suiko Reflects
1.plot: Unable to withstand any more bullying from her husband's sadistic boss, Shoko snaps and turns to the destructive powers of Suiko the tiger yokai.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E65 - Nation Founding Mabyo's Great Tottori Empire
1.plot: In a bizarre play to liven up Tottori Prefecture, its governor secedes from Japan. When Kitaro and his friends question why, the police arrest them.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E66 - The Shinigami and Sakaiminato's Hidden Village
1.plot: At a summer festival, Mana follows a strange voice that leads her out of sight. Her friends try to follow but the macabre yokai Shinigami interferes.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E67 - The Social Media Addict Versus The Jomon Man
1.plot: Rat Man builds an online following using photos of his new pal, a primitive caveman, sparking a battle for Likes with Mana's friend, Christine.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E68 - Capital Punishment! Exiled to the Underworld
1.plot: After crashing his stolen car, a criminal gets a ride with a strange chauffeur by the name of Kitaro, who says he'll take him to 'where he belongs.'

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E69 - General of the Underworld The Kido, Ibukimaru
1.plot: A strange young man warns Mana that her association with yokai imperils her life. Later, General Ibukimaru of the underworld takes a human hostage.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E70 - Spirit Affliction Mysterious Footprints
1.plot: Hoping to choose his own path in life, a young man plans to destroy a sacred rock his family has guarded for generations. He finds Kitaro in his way.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E71 - Karakasa's Umbrella Troubles
1.plot: Karakasa is shocked at how folk treat their umbrellas these days. When he sees a man mistakenly take the wrong one, it starts a wild goose chase.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E72 - Iyami the yokai's great love project
1.plot: After meeting an eccentric, love-obsessed yokai, Kitaro uncharacteristically asks Cat Girl on a date. Their friends smell a rat and tail the couple.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E73 - The Yamata-no-Orochi of Greed
1.plot: A selfish salaryman follows rumors of a wish-granting dragon and learns that it is real. But so are the tragic consequences of his avaricious wishes.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E74 - The Fall of the Underworld ?! Tamamo-no-Mae's Trap
1.plot: Enma demands Kitaro help him find a treasonous general or risk losing his freedom. Meanwhile, Rei Isurugi hatches a destructive plan to gain power.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E75 - Kyubi no Kitsune
1.plot: Rei insists he'll never give up, even as his body struggles under the burden of so many souls. Meanwhile, Tamamo-no-Mae lays waste to Hell.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E76 - Nurahiyon's Ambition
1.plot: Hell is back to normal but the culprit who unleashed the Generals remains at large. Meanwhile, a familiar yokai makes trouble at a construction site.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E77 - Vanishing Humans! Neko-Sennin's Revenge
1.plot: Kitaro senses that Nurarihyon is using violence to pit humans against each other and goes looking for him. But as always, his foe is one step ahead.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E78 - The Moryo of Mukuro Village
1.plot: Kitaro enters a cursed village to investigate the ties between a death-obsessed photographer and the Moryo, a corpse-dwelling yokai who's after him.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E79 - Komori-Neko's Halloween Pandemonium
1.plot: One spooky Halloween night, Backbeard's minion Komori Neko begs Rat Man to help him climb the ranks. Naturally, Rat Man agrees to help -- for a price.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E80 - Onmoraki's Trap
1.plot: After Mana notices her classmate Tsutomu acting like a zombie, she follows him home and spots someone acting even stranger. Kitaro decides to step in.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E81 - Hot Blooded Manga Artist: The Yōkai Hiderigami
1.plot: Cyclopic yokai Hiderigami has trouble breaking into the human comic business. Even when he finds a willing editor, Kitaro worries it won't end well.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E82 - Geriatric Nuppeppo
1.plot: After Rat Man gets rich from an anti-aging cream with a nasty effect, Kitaro follows a trail from the cream to the mysterious Nuppeppo yokai.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E83 - Chain of Hatred The Yōkai Hōkō
1.plot: Claiming to be looking for “Takumi,” a masked yokai begins assaulting humans. The attacks seem random but Kitaro finds a connection to a certain tree.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E84 - Chin-san, the Foreign Worker
1.plot: A peculiar yokai from southern lands comes to Japan for work, but his lack of familiarity with clothing causes trouble. Kitaro steps in to assist.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E85 - The Giant, Daidarabotchi
1.plot: After Rat Man witnesses a dark ceremony, the appearance of giant eyeballs over Kofu leads a yokai expert to pronounce the return of Daidarabotchi.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E86 - Bloody Christmas
1.plot: Mana's Christmas shopping trip is ruined when she runs into a strange being dressed as Santa who's been snatching kids off the street.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E87 - The Binbogami and The Zashiki-Warashi
1.plot: Mana visits her friend's family-run cafe and is impressed at how good the food is. But the place is empty, except for one suspicious-looking old man

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E88 - Rollo Cloth's Romance
1.plot: After his beloved singer rejects him, Ittan Momen's hurt feelings lead him to Rat Man's newest venture: a house shared by yokai and cute young women.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E89 - The Curse of Te-no-Me
1.plot: Visions of a strange man with eyes in his hands cause chaos in the legal world as Nurarihyon reveals a plot to pass a sweeping law against yokai.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E90 - Idol Legend Sazae-Oni
1.plot: When a video of Kitaro singing about mermaids becomes a hit, his friends are all shocked. They're even more shocked when he reveals it's not him.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E91 - The Misty Night of Angkor Wat
1.plot: Years after the two witness a tragic supernatural event at Angkor Wat, a famous director invites Kitaro to his new play to try and achieve closure.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E92 - The Writer is Ama-no-Jaku
1.plot: Desperate for new ideas for a show, a television director follows Rat Man to a hole in the woods, where the happiness-hating yokai Amanojaku awaits.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E93 - The Phantom Train
1.plot: After everyone else in the world is transformed into vampires, Cat Girl and Kitaro's dad race to find a phantom train to travel back to the past.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E94 - The Lazy Fujimi Hot Springs Bus Trip
1.plot: Mana joins her yokai friends on a trip to a hot spring inn. But its owner has a request for her and Kitaro that leads them into an old foe's trap.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E95 - The Great Yokai Alliance
1.plot: Forming a cold-blooded yokai alliance, Backbeard and Nurarihyon declare war on humanity. The government reacts by passing a strict anti-yokai law.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E96 - The Second Great Yokai War
1.plot: The bad guys toast their impending victory. Cat Girl says it's her turn to save the day and takes Mana with her to the underworld to confront Enma.

1.title: EN - GeGeGe no Kitaro [MULTI-SUB] - S01E97 - The World You See Isn't All There Is
1.plot: Using Rei and Ibukimaru's techniques, and Cat-girl's life, a portal is opened to another dimension. Mana searches for Kitaro, racing into that place which is neither this world nor the other. Finally, she catches sight of Kitaro, but...!? Meanwhile, moment by moment, the earth is pushed closer to the tipping point by Backbeard. How will this war end, and will Kitaro return?!

meta.plot: The Benny Hill Show is a British comedy television show that starred Benny Hill and aired in various incarnations between 15 January 1955 and 30 May 1991 in over 140 countries. The show focused on sketches that were full of slapstick, mime, parody, and double-entendre. Thames Television cancelled production of the show in 1989 due to declining ratings and large production costs at £450,000 per show.

meta.plot: Follow Yogu and his friends Amalia, Evangelyne, Tristepin, Ruel and Az as they try to rescue the world of Wakfu from destruction.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E01 - The Child from the Mist
1.plot: Grougaloragran, a mysterious and ancient entity, appears one with a baby carriage. After defeating a mysterious foe with powers over time, who wants Grougaloragran's life force, or "Wakfu", Grougaloragran comes across Alibert, who is quitting his profession as a bounty hunter after almost taking a innocent man to jail. Grougaloragran leaves the baby carriage with Alibert, believing that he will be a good father to the baby inside. He also leaves a message for the adoptive father, along with a baby Tofu (Bird). 12 years later, Alibert has opened an inn and established a small town. The boy, now called Yugo, believes himself to be a ordinary boy until he discovers that he has the ability to create portals. He puts it to the test when a monster rampages though town, ending up at his Inn. Ruel, who was passing though town, teams up with Yugo and defeats the beast, which turns out to have been a Iop possessed by a demon trapped in an item, in this case a sword known as a Shushu. Alibert, seeing Yugo's power, decides to tell him the truth: that he is adopted and that his real family is out there somewhere.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E02 - Yugo the Eliatrope
1.plot: The village is attacked by Polters, creatures that turn humans into shrubs, Yugo and his team go to the Forbidden Forest to find out why the Polters are doing this. Inside they encounter the ruler of the forest, the Soft Oak, who plans to turn all humans into trees in revenge for the destruction his forest has suffered. Amalia, a member of Yugo's party, convinces Soft Oak that not all men are like this and that only free men can protect the forests. She then heals him with magic and he agrees to turn the shrubs back into humans. In the village, Yugo and his father are attacked by the time villain from 12 years ago, now revealed to be a Xelor named Nox. Nox manipulates time to age Alibert rapidly and he calls Yugo a Eliatrope, swearing to get Yugo's Wakfu one day. Alibert, knowing that Yugo deserves to know the truth, tells him that his real family, the Eliatrope race, are out there somewhere at a place called Oma Island. Yugo's friends agree to help him find his real family and stop Nox and set off for the adventure.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E03 - The Black Crow
1.plot: The group goes to Kelba's market in search of a map to begin their quest. When they arrive they find the marketplace under attack by the Black Crow. The groups learns about a shop run by Kabrok, a old adventurer who hung up his cape and became a stock boy, and Miranda, who is Kabrok's strict, but loving, wife. They have a map the group can buy, but are unable to sell thanks to the Black Crow. The heroes lay a trap for the Black Crow and are able to take him down. The Black Crow is revealed to be Kabrok, who was bored with his life, craved adventure again, and felt that attacking the local merchants was the way to get it. Kabrok and his wife sell the group a map.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E04 - The Ugly Pageant
1.plot: Lost, the group finds themselves in front of a tower belonging to four sisters who wish to find the perfect husband. Percedal, completely smitten just by the top of one of their heads, climbs up to get a kiss. When he gets to the top, he finds that the sisters are actually ugly because of a curse put on them after the picky girls had ridiculed every single suitor. To be cured, one of them must be kissed by a man, and they hold Percedal captive until they get their kiss. The group dons disguises to get inside the tower. The nine of them decide to hold a little contest to see who will get the kiss from Pinpin, which ends up being pure torture. Things quickly go wrong when Eva enrages the sisters and causes them to attack the group. Freeing Pinpin, the group flees with the aid of one of the sisters, who believes that they got what they deserved and is sorry for what they did to Pinpin. As they flee, Pinpin blows the sister a kiss, which turns the sisters and their tower back to normal.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E05 - The Magnificent Five
1.plot: The group comes across a village of Puddles, cephalopod-like gelatinous creatures that turn into puddles. They are constantly attacked by a pack of Taures Bullies, wild bovine beasts that constantly raid their village for food. The group manages to fight them off, but know they will return as they always have. Not wanting to turn a blind eye to turmoil, and needing food themselves, the group decide to help train the Puddles so they can be ready for the next raid. The Bullies attack again, but the group, along with the Puddles, quickly overpower them. However, the Bullies brought one of their leaders, their father, Mandhal the Mighty. He proves to be a tough foe, even having his own beam attack, but Yugo uses his portal to deflect Father's beam attack back at him. With Father defeated, and worried about Mother finding out, the Bullies flee, leaving the Puddles to live in peace.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E06 - Vampyro
1.plot: With no other route to take, the group is forced to pass though an inhospitable town full of decay and zombie-like townsfolk. Vampyro, a vampire, comes to claim Eva as his wife, by using a magical ring to take her shadow, i.e. her soul. The group launches a rescue mission, avoiding ghouls launched by Vampyro. While scaling his castle, the group is overrun by vampire bats. Percedal volunteers to stay behind while the others go to rescue Eva. They arrive and find that Vampyro is using Eva's body as a vessel for his true love, Shadofang. Vampyro uses his shadow stealing powers on Ruel, turning him into a beast that Amalia eventually defeats. Amalia, Yugo, and Percedal fight Vampyro, but he proves to be too powerful. However, during the fight, they discover his weakness: he's allergic to Az, their mascot. the group uses Az to their advantage, overpowering Vampyro and getting the ring off of him. He turns back to his original self, a magistrate named Wagner. His release also turns the town and the townspeople back to normal and returns the shadows of Eva and Ruel.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E07 - Poisonous Beauty
1.plot: Amalia is bitten by a poisonous Red Rose. Ruel says that his old friend, an Eniripsa named Nausica, lives nearby and can help heal her. They learn that the only cure to a Red Rose bite is sap from the rare Severum tree, which is located deep in the nearby Maleficent forest. Ruel and Yugo leave to gather the sap while Percedal and Eva stay behind to help care for Amalia. Not long after Ruel and Yugo leave, Amalia's doll goes berserk, attacking Nausea, Percedal, and Eva. It merges with Rubilax, turning into a monstrous demon. The trio overpower it, forcing Rubilax out and cutting the doll up into pieces, but the pieces turn into other dolls and attack in masses. In the forest, Ruel and Yugo are attacked by giant Venus flytraps, but are saved by a forest dweller named Sybannak. They are forced to help her in exchange for the sap, but when the tasks become tedious and monotonous, Ruel instead decides to steal some sap. Enraged, Sybannak attacks with the Venus flytrap monsters. Rue and Yugo escape with the sap and return to Nausea's where they save Amalia and return the dolls back to normal.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E08 - Xav the Baker
1.plot: Following a very delicious smell, the group finds a man attacking a beast made entirely out of bread. They mistake the man for the attacker, only to later find out that the man, a innocent baker named Xav, was attacked by Breadnaughts who were after the rare Golden Wheat stored in his barn. Before the attack, Xav was going to enter a bread baking contest with the special wheat which is thought to produce exquisite bread. Wanting to fix their mistake, Yugo decides to help Xav make the bread while the others harvest the wheat. They enter the competition and with Yugo's help, Xav wins. The Breadnaught inadvertently reveals that she is Chouquette, Xav's father's former apprentice, and that she was after the wheat because she is in love with her master and wanted him to win.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E09 - Ruel's Bag
1.plot: The group is staying at Xav's place, and getting some tips on how to deal with Grufon from its original master, Gonnard the Great. A traveling herald passes though and tells the group that kamas (gold coins) are being stolen throughout the land. Ruel, afraid his own Kamas will be stolen, retreats into his magical bag, and uses a recall potion to return home. The others, Gonnard included, follow after him. They discover his home is built into a clay mesa and has a special code to keep intruders out and keep his stash of Kamas hidden. Gonnard reveals himself to be a shapeshifting genie that turns into whatever he eats, and as he eats kamas, he's as hard as gold. He overpowers the group and eats more kamas. Ruel, not one to give up his kamas, tricks him into eating chocolate coins instead. Gonnard eats them and turns into chocolate. Ruel traps him inside a glass vase and leaves Gonnard in his vault.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E10 - The Gobbowl inferno (1)
1.plot: Upon arriving to the city of Bonta, Yugo & co. try to buy a boat to get them to Oma Island, but it's expensive. So Ruel enters them in gobbowl match, with his old team, Real Gobbly, against professional player Kriss Krass & his team, Lamechester United.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E11 - The Gobbowl inferno (2)
1.plot: Ruel & his team, Real Gobbly, along with Percedal, play against opposing team, Lamechester United, led by professional gobbowl player, Kriss Krass.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E12 - The Gobbowl inferno (3)
1.plot: When Real Gobbly is on the verge of losing, Ruel sends in Yugo, Amalia & Eva for one last effort to win the match and get the boat to Oma Island.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E13 - Calm Blue Sea
1.plot: Having bought the boat with the kamas they earned in Bonta, Yugo and his friends go finally on the island of Oma. Only, it would seem that there is a stowaway on board of the ship, a passenger with willful intentions...

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E14 - Moon Island
1.plot: In the course of their trip at sea, the five friends encounter a terrible tempest and their boat is wrecked on an island. Yugo, Amalia and Evangelyne disembark in search of food, but primitive Sadida take them in hostage: these are Kaniboules! And it seems that they have the poor habit to give the foreigners in sacrifice in their godhead: big Moon... This smells bad for our heroes!

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E15 - Adamai
1.plot: Amalia, Tristepin and Evangélyne wake up on a tiny islet. The boat was attacked by a mythical living being, Kralamoure Géant, and sank into the abyss. By way of islet, there is a huge and green island protected by an ancient fate of invisibility. The mysterious island of Oma where there should be the true family of Yugo.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E16 - The Eliacube
1.plot: Yugo continues his exploration of the island of Oma with Adamaï, his brother dragon. During this time, by surveying the caverns, the companions discover the ruins of a very ancient temple kept by a terrible dragon! Stopping at nothing, the Grouilleux de Nox heads to the island!

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E17 - Grougaloragran the Eternal
1.plot: The battle between the dragon Grougaloragran and Nox rages. Having been sent to the ice of the big North, Yugo and his friends wait for the end of this ultimate battle, feeling tension because it is the World of Twelve that is at stake!

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E18 - The Brotherhood of the Tofu
1.plot: Grougaloragram failed... Our friends have to be divided into two groups: on one hand, Ruel, Tristepin, Amalia and Evangelyne set off towards the kingdom Sadida to tell them about the threat which Nox represents, on the other Yugo and Adamaï which go looking for the Dofus in which Grougaloragran is going to reincarnate...

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E19 - The Sadida Kingdom
1.plot: Since the departure of Amalia, the kingdom Sadida changed. The king is away and it is therefore Armand de Sheran Sharm, the brother of Amalia who governs the kingdom. During this time, Yugo and his brother Adamaï are still in search of the Dofus of Grouraloragran, but they do not know that Nox sent a formidable enemy in their wake...

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E20 - The Tree of Life
1.plot: The king Sadida is in the sanctum of the Tree of life, heart of the Kingdom Sadida which is mysteriously sick. Overstepping the ban of the prince Armand, Amalia and Evangelyne go to the King to tell it about the imminent attack of the Kingdom by Nox. But things do not turn out as they had envisaged it... During this time, Ruel searches a means to get away from the prison cell into which he was unfairly thrown...

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E21 - Igol
1.plot: Yugo and his brother Adamaï arrive on the famous island where Grougaloragran would have hidden the Dofus. Wanting to know about it more on his powers of Eliatrope, Yugo launches into a crossing of the Desert. But It would seem that the hunter of Nox, Igôle, has arrived on the island.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E22 - Rubilax
1.plot: Having hurt Evangelyne by employing from Rubilax in the Kingdom Sadida, our Iop finishes his escape in the desert and goes looking for the tomb of his ancient Master: Goultard. To his surprise, Goultard is not dead. Our Iop brain is going to discover how to become a true Shushu Guardian... He has to confront Rubilax and make him fear him.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E23 - The Quest for the Dofus
1.plot: Yugo and Adamaï reach the goal of their trip finally: the secret shrine in which Grougaloragran hid his Dofus. There, they make the acquaintance of the guardian of the Dofus. But Igôle did not die, contrary to what our heroes thought...

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E24 - Reunion
1.plot: The kingdom Sadida is on the brink of war, getting ready for the unavoidable attack of Nox. It is necessary to prevent the clock of Xélor from teleporting to the island at all costs. Amalia and Evangelyne wait without hoping too much for the return of their companions...

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E25 - I Am A Legend
1.plot: Nox and his troops land on the island. The Xélor attacks without deferring more from the purpose of his crusade: Wakfu contained in the Tree of Life. But the heart of the kingdom Sadida is protected by the colossal plant wall of the protective trees. Also the The Brotherhood of Tofu is in pursuit... Together, they well intend to hold the line.

1.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S01E26 - Mount Zinit
1.plot: The line did not hold and final battle to protect the Tree of Life begins. Our heroes have a last trump: Yugo and his brother Adamaï entered the clock without Nox knowing with the crazy hope of taking over Eliacube, source of the power of the Xélor. Everything rests on their shoulders...

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E01 - Monsters and Chimeras
2.plot: Yugo is reunited with his father. Evangelyne believes that Percedal isn't dead and that she hears his voice. Ruel gets in trouble while looking for treasure underground.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E02 - Rubilaxia
2.plot: Evangelyne searches for Sadlygrove and gets into a fight with Remington Smisse.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E03 - Remington Smisse
2.plot: Evangelyne goes after Remington who stole Sadlygrove.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E04 - Grovy's return
2.plot: Rubilax captures Amalia, Ruel and Yugo but Evangelyne and Sadlygrove come to the rescue.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E05 - The Dragon-Pig
2.plot: On their way back to Sadida the gang angers the legendary Dragon-Pig.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E06 - Qilby
2.plot: Yugo and Adamaï try to learn more about their people by activating the Eliacube but accidentally free Qilby.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E07 - Ambush
2.plot: The group starts their new adventure by taking a cable car and has to defend it against some black ravens.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E08 - Knight Justice
2.plot: Knight Justice takes Yugo and his friends prisoners because he holds them responsible for setting Rubilax free.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E09 - Rushu's World
2.plot: After getting dragged into the ShuShu realm by Anathar Yugo, Sadlygrove and Remington have to fight their way out of it.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E10 - Kriss la Krass
2.plot: Yugo defends Kriss Krass at court in Brakmar.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E11 - The Masked Boufbowler
2.plot: The gang and Kriss Krass play Boufbowl to save him from losing his head.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E12 - The Mmmmmmmmmporg
2.plot: The Masked Boufbowler changes sides. Now they have to fight the legendary Mmmmmmmmmporg.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E13 - The Night of the Thirsters
2.plot: The Pandawa people got turned into mindless zombies and nearly infest the whole group around Yguo, too.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E14 - The Voice Thief
2.plot: Ruel bets with the owner of an inn that he and his companions can stop the Voice Thief.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E15 - Wabbit Island
2.plot: Yugo and his friends fight through a dungeon to find a boat but they don't get what they expected.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E16 - The Cursed Fountain
2.plot: Evangelyne shows her soft side and the gang has to help to lift a curse off two lovers.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E17 - The Council ofTwelve
2.plot: Representatives of the twelve races gather in the Sadida Kingdom to hear Qilby's story.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E18 - Cléophée
2.plot: The group meets Cléophée, Evangelyne's sister.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E19 - A Fistful of Kamas
2.plot: Cléophée, Ruel, Sadlygrove and Yugo search for a boot but get into trouble with some pirates.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E20 - The Zinit
2.plot: Qilby shows his true face to Adamaï.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E21 - The Island of the Bellaphones
2.plot: Bellaphones bewitch the boys and the girls have to save them.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E22 - The Silence of the Rings
2.plot: Ruel plays dead to find a legendary treasure and the gang saves another pair of lovers.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E23 - The Crimson Claws
2.plot: Yugo and his friends arrive at Crimson Claw Island but they're not the first.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E24 - Phaeris the Powerful
2.plot: Yugo meets Phaeris, another dragon, who unlocks Yugo's true powers for his fight against Qilby.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E25 - The Blank Dimension
2.plot: Qilby tells Yugo his story and what he plans to do with the Eliacube while the other fight against Rushu.

2.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S02E26 - The Eliatrope People
2.plot: Yugo meets the Eliatrope children and together they fight Qilby.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E01 - Falling Down
3.plot: When a large pandawa arrives at the door of Tristepin and Evangelyne in the middle of a snowstorm, the family's life is turned upside down. Yugo and Ruel continue to seek out Adamai who has been missing since the battle against Ogrest. In the Sadida kingdom, Amalia stands vigil at the side of her dying father when Yugo and Ruel arrive bearing bad news.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E02 - Like Father, Like Daughter
3.plot: Having faced off against Adamai, Tristepin, Rubilax and Elely lie at the bottom of a ravine out in the snow. Dragging her father to safety, Elely takes on the pandawa head to head. Literally. In order to save his life, Pinpin makes a deal with Rubi.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E03 - Oropo's Tower
3.plot: Yugo, Amalia, Ruel, and Pinpin and Elely march towards Oropo's tower to rescue Evangelyne and Flopin. When Elely triggers a trap, the group are suspended in a temporal zone where each step ages them. Oropo probes the minds of the group, causing them to face their darkest fears.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E04 - Beastly Girl
3.plot: The gang, traumatized by the time bubble, enter Oropo's tower to rescue Eva and Flopin. Inside they meet an Osamodas girl, who tries to convince Elely that Oropo and his brotherhood are actually good.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E05 - A Iop Hides Himself to Cry
3.plot: The gang arrive at the Iop floor of the tower, which turns out to be protected by a corrupted Goultard, who goes by the name, "Dark Vlad". Percedal decides to fight him on his own and the fight brings back some memories of the moments the two of them shared.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E06 - The Ecaflip's Scratching Post
3.plot: Yugo, Amalia, Ruel, and Elely arrive at the Ecaflip floor of the tower. Its protector is Kerubim and Atcham's brother, Ush. Being an Ecaflip, he loves to gamble and invites the gang to play a deadly game.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E07 - Pinball Hazard
3.plot: The gang continue their journey to the top of the tower. At the Feca floor, they encounter a demigod named Bump. He is willing to let them pass without fight, but he has a peculiar condition: he wants Yugo, Ruel and Amalia's pants to add to his underwear collection.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E08 - Arpagone
3.plot: Arriving at the Enutrof floor, the gang find four doors, so they decide to split up in order to find the exit quicker. Along his way, Ruel reminisces about his youth and a girl he once loved named Arpagone. Ruel encounters Arpagone, who takes him captive so that a fake one can infiltrate the group. The Fake Ruel converses with Yugo about his love for Amalia, wondering if she'd ever feel the same ever she ever stopped the stubborn princess routine.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E09 - The Sadida Temple
3.plot: Yugo, Amalia, Elely, and fake Ruel arrive at the Sadida floor wherethey meet the Demi-God of the race, revealing that she doesn't want to fight, but to talk. She discovers the Fake Ruel among their party and captures him. Arpagone tries to convince the real Ruel to join her and Oropo. Evangelyne and Flopin manage to escape their prison but are intercepted by Toxine and Echo. Echo tries to persuade them to come back, but Toxine electrocutes her and chains her up as her hate for Echo trumps everything else. She goes into a sadistic fight against Flopin and Eva and they somehow manage to fight her off but launching her into a Well of Shadows – a representation of her own soul, dark, evil, and chaotic – but she fires an energy bolt as she falls in, striking Eva in the womb and electrocuting her.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E10 - When the Walls Fall Down
3.plot: Thanks to Toxine, Evangelyne goes into labor while the baby's godly powers activate, causing untold pain as she prepares to give birth with help from Echo, who is able to minimize the pain. The baby, having a demigod's strength, causes the tower to crumble from the shockwaves it emanated during labor. Only Oropo's power is preventing the tower itself from collapsing, but only barely. He sends Adamai to find the cause, finding it to be the son that is coming. He decides to keep them safe from the crumbling debris around them so that he and Echo can have a conversation later. Eva gives birth to a boy, ending the shockwaves and the pain, but the tower is in shambles. Oropo and Adamai set the pieces with those alive gently on the ground, allowing everyone to reunite and for Percedal to meet his new son. Before she could head over, however, Fake Ruel knocks out Amalia and transforms into a fake Amalia, sending the real one to Oropo.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E11 - Oropo
3.plot: Along with Amalia and sharing a tender kiss, Oropo tells the story of his birth, revealing his true identity and the motivation behind his actions. When Yugo used the Eliatrope Dofus' to help Percedal battle Ogrest, he had inadvertently created a time loop in which a shadow race, the Eliotropes, were created long ago. They were essentially copies of Yugo, but they slowly began to die off, leaving Oropo as the last.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E12 - The Hyperzaap
3.plot: Oropo is about to open the Hyperzaap and use it to destroy the gods. As he reveals his true intentions and the fact that he lied to everyone, with the Sadida Demi-Goddess revealing that it was he who set the world's tragedies into motion, such as Nox finding the Eliacube and Ogrest turning into the demon he was, his brotherhood of demigods start to turn against him. He uses his powers to send Yugo into a coma, where he confronts his demons in the forms of Qilby and Nox, who he had been suffering waking nightmares from since he arrived at the tower.

3.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S03E13 - Inglorium
3.plot: The Brotherhood of the Tofu and the demigods join forces to stop Oropo from killing the gods in a final battle that will decide the fate of the World of Twelve, and the universe. After a climatic battle, Oropo activates the Hyperzaap. In a last act of self-sacrifice, Echo uses her powers to send Yugo's group and the Demi-Gods though the Hyperzaap, leaving her and Oropo, who still loves her, to die as the Eliacube creates a massive black hole that destroys Oropo's dimension. Yugo and his friends find themselves in Inglorium, the realm of the gods.

4.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S04E01 - Far from the World
4.plot: As strange eyes appear over different regions of the World of Twelve, the Brotherhood of the Tofu moves through the devastated landscape of Ingloriom towards a temple bathed in an intriguing glow. They have no idea who they're about to meet in the ruins of this dimension, let alone the revelations that await Yugo in the only temple left standing.

4.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S04E02 - The Goddess of Love
4.plot: Inside the temple, the Goddess Eliatrope welcomes her sons and their friends. Still exhausted from their recent fight with Oropo, the group decides to split up and return to the World of Twelve.

4.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S04E03 - A New World
4.plot: Back in the Sadida Kingdom, Amalia learns some tragic news. Meanwhile, Yugo is getting to know his sister a little better. Far across the World of Twelve, an old man continues his journey. And at the Stroud home, Ruel wakes up to a very unpleasant surprise.

4.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S04E04 - The Assembly
4.plot: The World of Twelve's leaders gather in response to recent events. Accompanied by his mother, Yugo tries to explain their reasoning to the assembled dignitaries. Unfortunately, his words don't have the desired effect. Meanwhile, a new threat draws closer to the Sadida Kingdom.

4.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S04E05 - Necromas
4.plot: As Necros approach Albuera Island, Armand and Amalia are horrified to see the destruction that the creatures have wrought in their kingdom. But that's only the start of the troubles that Yugo and his friends will soon be drawn into. Elsewhere, the Sadlygrove family receives a most unusual visit.

4.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S04E06 - RotalStröm
4.plot: Amalia and Yugo, confronted with a new wave of Necros in the Sadida Kingdom, try to repel the assault. Meanwhile, on Albuera Island, another attack is underway, led by an enormous Necro Dragon. The monsters are getting dangerously close to shore.

4.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S04E07 - Toross Mordal
4.plot: Evangelyne takes the time to listen to Madagaskane, despite a bit of hesitation. Meanwhile, Yugo starts negotiations with the leaders of the World of Twelve to get their help against the Necros.

4.title: EN - Wakfu [Multi-Sub-Audio] - S04E08 - Traitor

Every last Thursday of the month at an all-girls high school, the students of Class 2–5 cast their votes in a popularity poll. The results classify them into Grades A, B, C, D, and F. If they fall into Grade F, they become legitimate victims of school violence.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E01 - Sung Soo Ji: The Transfer Student
1.plot: Soo Ji transfers to Baekyeon Girls’ High School and discovers that her class plays a game called the Pyramid Game in which the students decide on a hierarchy based on a popular vote. As Soo Ji ends up in the lowest rank, she devises a plan to get back on her feet.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E02 - The Mastermind of the Pyramid Game
1.plot: Soo Ji is determined to figure out the characteristics of her classmates and the mastermind behind the Pyramid Game. She also tries to join forces with other girls who seem vulnerable. She even asks her homeroom teacher for help, only to be disappointed. Meanwhile, the 14th Pyramid Game begins, and Ja Eun, who kept skipping school, shows up.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E03 - The Birth of a Trio
1.plot: Soo Ji moves up to Grade C, and the treatment she gets changed completely overnight. She breaks the promise she made with Ja Eun, but she decides to join hands with her and help the new girl in Grade F, Pyo Ji Ae. Soo Ji, Ja Eun, and Ji Ae come up with a plan to destroy the pyramid altogether.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E04 - The Leaked Plan
1.plot: Soo Ji begins to feel uneasy about the unfolding events, suspecting that her plan may have been compromised and that Ha Rin is catching on. Learning this, Pyo Ji Ae worries she may have made a mistake and dreads the potential consequences. Meanwhile, Soo Ji hints to Hae Jun that she holds leverage over her, coercing Hae Jun into assisting her. Soo Ji recruits a hacker to join her team.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E05 - Parent Observation Day
1.plot: During the parents' visit to the school, Soo Ji gets caught up in Ha Rin's trap. While Soo Ji tries to make a pact with Do Ah,  Seung Yi puts on a show to put Soo Ji on the spot. Although the parents witness the ordeal, Ha Rin turns the situation to her advantage and even has her grandmother, the chairwoman of Baekyeon Group. Meanwhile, Soo Ji switches to her Plan B.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E06 - Tables Turned
1.plot: With no Grade F in the 15th game, Soo Ji changes gears to eliminate the game with Ye Lim's help. First, she suggests voting to revoke Grade A privileges and puts Ha Rin on the spot. Meanwhile, Ha Rin doesn't give in to Soo Ji's hindrances and thinks of a plan to demolish Soo Ji's game.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E07 - Shattering Friendship

The next day, Class Five plays a survival game using paint guns. The last five standing, Soo Ji, Ja Eun, Jae Hyung, Eun Jung, and Ji Ae are put in danger of ending up in Grade F.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E08 - The Majority
1.plot: Soo Ji decides to recruit more girls to end the game and Ha Rin for good. When Da Yeon is about to be punished for what she did to Eun Jung, their teacher tells everyone that Da Yeon has to transfer to another school. Meanwhile, right before the Pyramid Game is held, Ye Lim gets taken to the hospital.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E09 - The Final Vote
1.plot: The 16th Pyramid Game begins, and Ha Rin suggests choosing a classmate who will become a permanent Grade F. Before the voting takes place, Soo Ji tells the class that Ye Lim was attacked and hospitalized. The class decides to vote on whether to stay. playing or not, and the entire process is broadcast live, causing the school to be in an uproar. Meanwhile, Ja Eun tells Soo Ji what she did to Ha Rin when they were little.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E10 - The Verdict

The school and Baekyeon Group decide to blame Soo Ji and her group for the violence at school, but Ms. Yoon Na Hee takes action and reveals the video of Soo Ji being bullied. Meanwhile, Soo Ji reveals the corruption behind the teacher recruitment.

meta.plot: V.C. Andrews' Landry Family follows Ruby Landry, who after being raised by her loving spiritual healer grandmother in the Louisiana bayou, is ensnared in a world of dark family secrets and betrayal, upon discovering that she has another family living in New Orleans.

1.plot: Watched over by her loving Grandmère Catherine, Ruby Landry is filled with hope as love blooms with her high school sweetheart Paul Tate, but lingering thoughts of her mysterious father and her mother's death often creep into Ruby's mind. As dark family secrets begin to reveal themselves when Paul's parents forbid him from seeing Ruby, Ruby is further devastated when her beloved Grandmère passes away. Forced to flee to New Orleans from the Bayou, Ruby searches for her estranged father, one of the richest men in the city, as she clings to her memories of Paul and their forbidden love.

1.plot: Pearl in the Mist finds Ruby still struggling to find true happiness, after a year of living at her father's lavish mansion. When Ruby and her twin Giselle are sent away to an exclusive all girls boarding school, Ruby is hopeful for a new start with her sister. But when Ruby is once again shamed for her backwater upbringing, and her cruel Headmistress, Mrs. Ironwood, along with her stepmother Daphne and Giselle continue to plot against her, Ruby must endure torturous punishments and public humiliation. Ruby holds out hope and continues to dream of a better future until tragedy leaves her alone in a world of deceits.

1.title: FR - V.C. Andrews' Landry Family - S01E03 - All That Glitters
1.plot: All That Glitters picks up as Ruby is driven from the Dumas mansion and returns to her beloved childhood home in the bayou where she's intent on creating a new life for her baby girl, Pearl. Ruby's high school sweetheart, Paul, once again is there to support her, and when he moves her into his impressive home, she has new hope for the future. However, Ruby can't escape the judging eyes of Paul's mother Gladys who knows Ruby and Paul's dark secret and Giselle continues to torment Ruby when she reveals news about Beau, Pearl's real father and Ruby's true love. Ruby longs for another life. The web of deceit continues when Giselle falls into a coma and Ruby finds herself lured into a twisted plan to be with Beau.

1.title: FR - V.C. Andrews' Landry Family - S01E04 - Hidden Jewel
1.plot: Hidden Jewel finds Ruby trying to find a new life for her children and desperate to protect her beloved daughter from the dark secrets she harbors. Raised amidst the privileges in New Orleans, Pearl aspires to become a doctor, but when an unfortunate accident occurs to one of her twin brothers, Pearl's dreams are threatened and Ruby runs, once again back to the bayou. And when one of Pearl's younger brothers becomes deathly ill, she must journey to the backwaters to find her mother and uncover the mysterious secrets of her past.
