meta.plot: De joies en déceptions, les vies amoureuses et professionnelles de Laure, Caroline et Jessica ne manquent jamais de rebondissements sous le soleil de Saint Tropez !
A horrific murder upends the Chicago Prosecuting Attorney's Office when one of its own is suspected of the crime—leaving the accused fighting to keep his family together.

1.title: FR - Présumé innocent - S01E01 - Bases Loaded
1.plot: Chief deputy prosecutor Rusty Sabich is determined to investigate the horrific murder of his colleague Carolyn Polhemus.

1.title: FR - Présumé innocent - S01E02 - People vs. Rozat Sabich
1.plot: Tommy Molto continues to build his case as Raymond comes to Rusty's defense.

1.title: FR - Présumé innocent - S01E03 - Discovery
1.plot: Rusty learns of the evidence against him. Barbara looks to protect herself and her family as new secrets emerge.

1.title: FR - Présumé innocent - S01E04 - The Burden
1.plot: Kyle is confronted about his whereabouts the night of the murder. Tommy questions Carolyn's son when the case takes a complicated turn.

1.title: FR - Présumé innocent - S01E05 - Pregame
1.plot: Raymond insists Rusty is innocent, but the weight of the looming trial pushes the Sabich family to its breaking point.

1.title: FR - Présumé innocent - S01E06 - The Elements
1.plot: The trial begins. Startling events inside the courtroom threaten to derail proceedings.

1.title: FR - Présumé innocent - S01E07 - The Witness
1.plot: Rusty is forced to pivot his legal strategy. Tommy receives a disturbing message.

1.title: FR - Présumé innocent - S01E08 - The Verdict
1.plot: The truth behind Carolyn's murder is revealed.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E01 - Ji A Looks For A Psychic | Dream Officetel
1.plot: Hong Ji-a looks to hire help for a difficult assignment, but it seems none can stand up to the task. Oh In-beom's client takes his business elsewhere.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E02 - Father And Son | Britium, The Art Museum
1.plot: Despite her disapproval of frauds like In-beom, Ji-a knows she desperately needs his special ability. In-beom turns his attention to his next job.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E03 - Team Daebak | The Artist
1.plot: In-beom agrees to a partnership with Ji-a, hoping to find out more about the death of his uncle. Ji-a scans an art gallery for spirits.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E04 - Side Effect | The Truth Unraveled
1.plot: In-beom is plagued by memories that are not his. But when he also inherits a talent he never had, he seeks to exploit it for profit.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E05 - Mother & Daughter | Life in Vain
1.plot: Ji-a encounters two spirits: a victim of real estate fraud who does not realize she is dead and her mother's last client.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E06 - Faceless Boy | The Basement Wall
1.plot: Despite Ji-a's warning, In-beom involves himself in a murder case. Ji-a questions her memory of the events leading up to her mother's death.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E07 - A Sweet Tooth | Reconciliation
1.plot: Ji-a seeks new insight into the incident that happened 20 years ago. In-beom spots a familiar face in the lobby of Dohak Construction.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E08 - Eun-byeol, The Child Spirit | Oh Seong-sik's Mother
1.plot: Ji-a's next job takes her to an apartment complex that is haunted by the ghost of a child. Do Hak-seong looks for a missing document.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E09 - Murder In A Parking Lots | The Police Interfere
1.plot: In-beom returns to his grandmother’s home. Ji-a buries herself in her books. A woman calls the agency after being tormented by a spirit in her building.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E10 - Luring A Murderer | A Mother To The Rescue
1.plot: Bae Su-jeong seeks to repay a debt. In-beom learns what became of his uncle. A new client visits Daebak Realty with stories of ghosts in a warehouse.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E11 - Ji-a Forfeits Daebak Reality | Do Hak-seong's Exorcism
1.plot: Ji-a finds out what had kept her mother from moving on. In-beom investigates the two life-threatening incidents and their relationship to Hak-seong.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E12 - Oh Sung Sik's Memories | The Egg Ghost
1.plot: In-beom relives Oh Seong-sik’s last days. Ji-a’s search comes to another dead end. Hak-seong finally gets his hands on the property he wanted.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E13 - Ji-a Quits Being an Exorcist | Chang-hwa Returns Home
1.plot: Ji-a recovers her memories and confronts the person who planted fake ones in her mind. She seeks solace to clear her head.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E14 - The Jackpot | In-beom Goes After Do Hak-seong
1.plot: When guilt sends Ji-a down a spiral, In-beom makes sure she’s not alone. Hak-seong grows desperate as the corruption investigation narrows in on him.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E15 - The Egg Ghost Returns | Do Hak-seong Hunts Ji-a
1.plot: Ji-a decides to put her life on the line before the faceless ghost is able to cause more damage. Hak-seong prepares for revenge.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E16 - A Glorious Injury | Ji-a Loses Her Power
1.plot: The special ending Ji-a had prepared for Hak-seong causes an unexpected side effect. She asks In-beom to help her one final time.

meta.plot: A real estate agent who rids haunted buildings of vengeful ghosts, partners with a con man to solve a 20-year-old case that is close to her heart.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E01 - First Light
1.plot: Tandy Bowen and Tyrone Johnson – two teenagers from very different backgrounds, find themselves burdened and awakened to newly acquired superpowers which are mysteriously linked to one another. The only constant in their lives is danger and each other. Tandy can emit light daggers and Tyrone has the ability to control the power of darkness. They quickly learn they are better together than apart.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E02 - Suicide Sprints
1.plot: Tandy and Tyrone try to grasp what has happened to them with their new-found powers, while Tandy’s past catches up with her and Tyrone becomes consumed with revenge. Meanwhile, Detective Brigid O’Reilly works an interesting case that has ties to Tandy.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E03 - Stained Glass
1.plot: Tandy is on the run as Detective O’Reilly closes in on her, but the detective may not be after her for the reasons Tandy thinks. Tyrone is desperate for answers and turns to Evita and her Auntie Clarisse, a Voodoo priestess, for help.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E04 - Call/Response
1.plot: Tandy and Tyrone come face-to-face as the two are able to sit down and talk. Having not been able to tell anyone else what they have been experiencing, both take the opportunity to finally confide in the one person who may truly understand what they are going through. Meanwhile, Otis reveals a secret side of himself and Greg seems to be onto something with Melissa’s case against Roxxon.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E05 - Princeton Offense
1.plot: Tandy is consumed with getting answers about the Roxxon cover up. To get the answers she is looking for, Tandy tests out her power to gain new insights. Tyrone, on the other hand, is focusing on being a normal kid as the basketball state finals approach. With so much weighing on him lately, can he truly push everything to the side and win the big game for Billy? Meanwhile, Det. O’Reilly looks into the city’s drug problems to get some answers of her own.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E06 - Funhouse Mirrors
1.plot: Tyrone heads down a dangerous path to get closer to Det. Connors, as Tandy pretends to be a Roxxon intern in an attempt to get answers. Her “internship” hits a little too close to home for Tandy when she gets a glimpse at what her life could have been like. Meanwhile, Det. O’Reilly gets closer to Det. Connors and Evita’s Aunt Clarisse worries about Tyrone’s future.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E07 - Lotus Eaters
1.plot: A mysterious man may be the key for Tandy to finally clear her father’s name. Unfortunately, getting the answers she needs will be difficult as the man has been in a catatonic state for almost a decade, but it might not be so impossible for two people with extraordinary powers. With Tyrone alongside to help, the two test their combined powers for the first time.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E08 - Ghost Stories
1.plot: Tandy and Melissa prepare to commemorate the 8th anniversary of Nathan’s passing with their annual memorial tradition. When Tandy gets a key piece of information regarding her father, she uses this day to try and finally clear her father’s name. Meanwhile, Tyrone’s parents prefer not to mark the day Billy passed, but Tyrone’s need to keep Billy’s memory alive causes conflict among the three. Deciding today is the day he gets a confession out of Det. Connors, Tyrone goes to Det. O’Reilly for help.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E09 - Back Breaker
1.plot: When triumph turns sour, both Tandy and Tyrone regress back to their old ways. But after everything that has happened, and actions that have been set into motion, can they truly go back to the way things once were? Meanwhile, Det. O’Reilly tries to deal with the recent fallout.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E10 - Colony Collapse
1.plot: Everything comes to a head for Tyrone and Tandy as the city of New Orleans is thrown into chaos. The two realize that it is time they face their destiny and test their powers as “The Divine Pairing” to save the city.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E01 - Restless Energy
2.plot: Now living very different lives, Tyrone and Tandy try to stay under the wire while still honing their powers. After coming to terms with their destiny, the two now find it difficult to just stand by and do nothing while bad things continue to happen throughout the city. Meanwhile, Brigid is struggling from her recovery.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E02 - White Lines
2.plot: Desperate to help, but only finding they cause more problems than solving them, Tyrone and Tandy continue to struggle with their situation. What is the point of having superpowers if you only seem to make things worse?

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E03 - Shadow Selves
2.plot: After learning about a group of young girls who have gone missing, Tandy and Tyrone look to see if they can find out what has happened to them. As they get further into their investigation, they realize someone else is trying to rescue the girls too, but in her own vigilante justice type of way. Meanwhile, Mina may have discovered a side effect to the big Roxxon leak.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E04 - Rabbit Hold
2.plot: Still on her quest to find out more about the sex trafficking ring, Tandy takes a dangerous trip to find Mayhem, who may have the answers she is looking for. Meanwhile, Tyrone’s past actions catch up to him and put Adina in harm’s way.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E05 - Alignment Chart
2.plot: Tyrone is faced with a hard decision when presented with an opportunity to clear his name from an unlikely source. Meanwhile, Tandy is letting her anger get the best of her as she becomes frustrated with a possible dead end to her investigation into the sex trafficking ring.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E06 - B Sides
2.plot: In her quest to bring down the sex trafficking ring, Tandy finds herself in a difficult and strange situation. Not sure what is going to happen, she always has Tyrone to lean on, no matter what the circumstance.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E07 - Vikingtown Sound
2.plot: Adina is pushed to a dangerous edge as she looks to get answers and closure for her two boys. Meanwhile, Tyrone comes in contact with a mysterious figure on his search for Tandy.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E08 - Two Player
2.plot: Tandy and Evita must go to great lengths when Tyrone is put in a dangerous situation. Meanwhile, Adina looks to someone surprising for help.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E09 - Blue Note
2.plot: Tyrone and Tandy turn to questionable allies in their attempt to find and stop the villain behind the trafficking ring. Meanwhile, Tandy learns more about Lia's past.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E10 - Level Up
2.plot: Tyrone and Tandy head to the Loa dimension to stop the evil force threatening New Orleans. To finally put an end to it, they must come face to face with their own personal issues that have been holding them back.

meta.plot: Two teenagers from very different backgrounds awaken to newly acquired superpowers which mysteriously link them to one another.

Tomozaki is one of the best gamers in Japan, and in his opinion, the game of real life is one of the worst. No clear-cut rules for success, horribly balanced, and nothing makes sense. But then he meets a gamer who’s just as good as him, and she offers to teach him a few exploits…

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Say what you want; famous games are usually fun
1.plot: Ace gamer Fumiya Tomozaki has given up on the “garbage game” of life, until a classmate offers to teach him the rules of this ultimate god-tier game.

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - It feels awesome to gain a bunch of levels after a battle
1.plot: Hinami tasks Tomozaki with starting and joining conversations; after his first few attempts fall flat, he comes away with some astute observations.

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - When a girl’s your first friend, life feels like a date for a while
1.plot: With Hinami’s help, Tomozaki gets a crash course in dressing well and talking to girls, getting unexpectedly close to one classmate in particular.

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Sometimes you conquer a dungeon only to find a strong boss back in your village
1.plot: Tomozaki begins tutoring Izumi in his favorite game, comes clean to Kikuchi, and gets roped into playing against the vengeful Nakamura after school.

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The characters who become your friends after you clear a hard event usually have high stats
1.plot: Tomozaki makes a new friend, then goes on a shopping trip for Nakamura’s birthday—of all things. Naturally, Hinami turns it into a teaching moment.

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Once you start speedrunning the minigames, you seriously can’t stop
1.plot: The student council election is approaching, and Tomozaki joins Mimimi’s campaign. Turns out they both have their reasons for wanting to beat Hinami.

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - When a mentor character becomes a boss, they’ll push you to the edge
1.plot: Tomozaki brings his gamer’s cunning to Mimimi’s campaign speech—but Hinami’s a gamer, too. Tama tells Tomozaki how she and Mimimi became friends.

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - There are some problems a bottom-tier character can’t fix alone
1.plot: Mimimi’s at her breaking point. A deeper dive into her past reveals why she’s so driven to beat Hinami, while Hinami’s motivation remains a mystery.

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - When you go back to the starter town with the full party, new stuff tends to happen
1.plot: Tomozaki rehearses with Hinami to prepare for his movie date with Kikuchi and is invited to an overnight barbecue with his popular normie classmates.

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Multiplayer games have their own special appeal
1.plot: Tomozaki gets a taste of the traditional overnight normie camp activities he’d always shunned as the group plots to get Izumi and Nakamura together.

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - A single choice can change everything
1.plot: An overheard conversation between Mizusawa and Hinami gives Tomozaki a different perspective on his private lessons in conquering the game of life.

1.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Equipment for girls has special effects
1.plot: A talk with Kikuchi helps Tomozaki realize what he really wants, and a confrontation with Hinami sets the course for the future of their relationship.

2.title: EN - Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - The best games make reconnaissance fun
2.plot: As the second term begins, Tomozaki's first task (courtesy of Hinano) is getting popular girl Erika Konno motivated for the school sports tournament.

meta.plot:
Babar is a Canadian/French/Japanese animated television series produced in Quebec, Canada by Nelvana Limited and The Clifford Ross Company. It premiered in 1989 on CBC and HBO, subsequently was rerun on HBO Family and Qubo. The series is based on Jean de Brunhoff's original Babar books, and was Nelvana's first international co-production. The series' 78 episodes have been broadcast in 30 languages in over 150 countries. Episodes of Babar currently air on Ion Television and Qubo.

While the French author Laurent de Brunhoff pronounces the name Babar as "BUH-bar", the TV series in its first five seasons pronounces the name as "BAB-bar".

In 2010, a computer-animated sequel series spin-off of Babar titled Babar and the Adventures of Badou was launched. The new series focuses on a majority of new characters.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E01 - Babar's First Step
1.plot: This story begins to tell the classic tale of Babar's early life with his mother and all the other elephants in the jungle, and how his life is shattered when a hunter kills his Mother and he must cope on his own.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E02 - City Ways
1.plot: Forced to run away from the jungle by the Hunter, Babar makes his way to the City only to find it just as dangerous and confusing. Motherless and alone, Babar is befriended by the Old Lady, who tries to teach him how to fit into her world, with his ultimate test at a society dinner in his honour.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E03 - Babar Returns
1.plot: Babar leaves the Old Lady and City to return to the jungle so he can bring the other elephants his newfound knowledge. However, he discovers that despite the fact that his old friends are still running from the Hunter, they resist trying out any of his â€˜new' ideas.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E04 - The City of Elephants
1.plot: As the Elephants' new King, Babar's first decree is to build a city for all the elephants. However, not only does Babar have to contend with the fact that Lord Rataxes is also trying to build a city, his own obsession to see his dream city completed on time creates insurmountable problems.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E05 - Babar's Triumph
1.plot: When the Hunter returns to threaten Babar's kingdom, Babar faces his greatest challenge as King when he unites Lord Rataxes and everyone in the jungle in an all out effort to fight the Hunter and repel him for once and for all.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E06 - Babar's Choice
1.plot: At an important palace ball, Babar's advisors Cornelius and Pompadour jeopardize Babar's relationship with Celeste by forcing Babar to take the visiting dignitary's daughter to the dance instead of her.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E07 - Race to the Moon
1.plot: Babar's hopes of rebuilding an old theater dedicated to his mother are jeopardized when all his subjects get caught up trying to build a rocketship in a silly attempt to beat Lord Rataxes to the moon.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E08 - No Place Like Home
1.plot: Babar decides to let a young circus boy live in the palace, but when the boy regrets his decision and wants to return to his circus home, he discovers it might be too late since the circus has been captured by Lord Rataxes.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E09 - An Elephant's Best Friend
1.plot: Times are hard for Babar when Lord Rataxes stops all pomegranate shipments from reaching Celesteville. However, when Babar finds a pet warthog in the jungle, Rataxes suddenly says he's willing to negotiate. What Babar doesn't realize is the warthog belongs to Lady Rataxes, and Rataxes has to grab it back before she or Babar discover that he lost it on purpose.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E10 - The Show Must Go On
1.plot: When Babar organizes a world class ballet to be performed in Celesteville, the star of the show, a temperamental prima ballerina, makes problems for his friends in the cast and crew and turns Babar's production into a disaster.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E11 - To Duet Or Not to Duet
1.plot: Babar is scheduled to perform a duet with a great pianist at a concert. However, he refuses to admit that the piece of music is too hard for him, so he procrastinates practicing until he feels so guilty that it begins to affect his job as King.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E12 - The Missing Crown Affair
1.plot: When Babar's crown goes missing, amateur sleuth Zephir decides to help Babar solve the mystery. However they both get panicky when all the clues point out that Babar's closest friends stole the crown as the first step to taking over his kingdom.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E13 - The Phantom

Unfortunately, the Phantom resents the meddling and scares Babar's friends away to the point where they decide the theatre should be torn down.

meta.plot: The year is 1931. Prince Tokugawa Yoshinobu holds absolute control over Japan. Remnants of the Meiji era’s culture can be seen around the city, but scientific technology and Japanese esoteric cosmology Onmyodo are also developing. Yet lurking behind the glitz is Kuchinawa, a dissident group planning the assassination of the prince. Tasked to extinguish these dissidents is Nue, the government’s secret executioner group. Sawa Yukimura, who works for this organization, suffered at the hands of the Kuchinawa boss. Her entire family was murdered and she dedicated her life to avenging their death.

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Confidential File 101, The Blue Flower of Carnage
1.plot: The year is 1931, the 64th year of the Meiji era. The 15th Shogun, Yoshinobu Tokugawa, continues to wield absolute power thanks to complete monopolization of a special natural resource known as "Ryumyaku." Supporting the Tokugawa regime from the shadows are the deadly agents of the covert organization known as Nue.

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Confidential File 033, The Treasurer
1.plot: With confidential Nue files having been leaked to their enemies at Kuchinawa, a search is underway for the traitor who provided the information.

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Confidential File 614, The Enemy Within
1.plot: Asahi and Yukimura struggle with the nature of their relationship, while the mole leaking Nue secrets is found... or is he?

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Confidential File 099, Kuchinawa
1.plot: Asahi has been kidnapped by Janome, and loyalties are called into question all throughout Nue. Will Yukimura be able to save her adopted sister in time? And will her employers in the Tokugawa government even let her try?

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Confidential File 620, Divine Right
1.plot: Now that her revenge is complete, Sawa doesn't know what to do with herself. With Tsukishima on the run and Elena facing a major change, what will become of the agents of Nue now that their primary target has been dealt with?

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Confidential File 623, Daybreak
1.plot: It's become clear that Nue agents don't leave the shogun's service and live to tell the tale, so it's up to Asahi to find a way for Sawa to break free of the life of violence she's become trapped in.

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Confidential File 637, A Fleeting Spring
1.plot: After faking Sawa's death, she and Asahi have fled Tokyo for a peaceful life in the country... but can they really escape the cycle of killing?

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Confidential File 642, The Witching Hour
1.plot: Sawa's brief respite from the cycle of violence has been irreversibly shattered. But even if she defeats the monster who brought an end to her dream, will she have anything left afterwards?

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Confidential File 668, Ethereal Love
1.plot: With her life in tatters, Sawa struggles to find a reason to keep going. Accompanied by another Nue executioner, she decides to look to her past while considering her future.

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Confidential File 089, Star Sign
1.plot: Jin Kuzuhara is the ruthless, enigmatic head of the shogun's personal group of assassins, Nue. But how did he come to serve the Tokugawa regime? And what is his secret connection to Sawa?

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Confidential File 701, Past and Future
1.plot: Sawa confronts Jin Kuzuhara about the truth behind what happened to her family and her village, but before she can get real answers a squadron of the shogun's troops arrives to try and capture her.

1.title: EN - Joran: The Princess of Snow and Blood [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Confidential File 707, The Land of Blessed Words
1.plot: Asahi is alive, but Sawa has seen too much to ignore the crimes perpetrated by Jin Kuzuhara in the name of the Tokugawa regime. Hoping to secure a brighter future for the girl she has adopted as a sister, the assassin once known as Yukimura takes up her sword once again...

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E01 - A Fresh Start
1.plot: As America reckons with a pandemic and racial injustice, Bubba Wallace is moved to perform an act of resistance and make a name for himself in NASCAR.

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E02 - Great Expectations
1.plot: After his bold statement on CNN, Bubba teams with an icon and a competitor.  Expectations run high at the Daytona 500 as the races comes to a fiery finish.

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E03 - Driving While Black
1.plot: Feeling immense pressure to win, Bubba aims for Victory Lane in Atlanta and Bristol.  At Martinsville Speedway, he debuts a special message on his car.

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E04 - The Inner Voice
1.plot: Bubba reveals his struggle with depression amid personal rough patches on and off track.  A disturbing discovery leads to a show of NASCAR unity.

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E05 - The Road to Success
1.plot: After the results of an FBI investigation open Bubba to more criticism, road courses in Austin and Sonoma present their own set of challenges.

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E06 - Engine of Change
1.plot: With sponsors lined up and several races left in the season, Bubba tries to manage his emotions and make the playoffs as NASCAR works to embrace change.

meta.plot: This docuseries follows Bubba Wallace, the only Black driver currently in NASCAR's Cup Series, as he uses his voice and talent to change the sport.
An enigmatic magician living in an abandoned amusement park introduces magic into the life of a high schooler struggling with harsh realities.

1.title: EN - The Sound of Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Do you... believe in magic?
1.plot: Yoon Ah-yi’s silent scream for help is answered by Ri-eul, who appears before her during a time of need and makes her wonder: is he really a magician?

1.title: EN - The Sound of Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Don't let me dream any longer
1.plot: Set on exposing Ri-eul's secrets, Baek Ha-na enters the theme park with a camera and captures Ah-yi inside. Na Il-deung asks Ah-yi on a study date.

1.title: EN - The Sound of Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Merry-go-round
1.plot: Il-deung and Ah-yi make a deal to try to make each other's lives easier. Suspicious about Ri-eul, Il-deung secretly follows Ah-yi to her magic lessons.

1.title: EN - The Sound of Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Becoming an adult
1.plot: Il-deung begins questioning his path. Ha-na discovers shocking footage in the hidden camera from Ri-eul's room. Ah-yi finds comfort from the future.

1.title: EN - The Sound of Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Curse of asphalt
1.plot: Ha-na infuriates Ri-eul by snooping for evidence in his room. The police ask Ah-yi questions about a caped person of interest.

1.title: EN - The Sound of Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The last performance
1.plot: Through a longtime friend, Ah-yi and Il-deung learn of Ryu Min-hyuk's pained past. The magician disappears from the interrogation room.

1.title: EN - Business Proposal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: To appease his grandfather's wishes, Kang Tae-moo agrees to a blind date. Jin Young-seo enlists Shin Ha-ri's help to scare away her latest prospect.

1.title: EN - Business Proposal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Tae-moo lies about having a girlfriend to stop the endless barrage of blind dates, with the perfect person in mind to play the part.

1.title: EN - Business Proposal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Ha-ri has a long list of facts about Tae-moo to memorize — as well as someone important to meet. Young-seo declares her independence.

1.title: EN - Business Proposal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: In and outside of work, Ha-ri scrambles to hide her true identity from Tae-moo and his grandfather. A fake one-year anniversary comes up.

1.title: EN - Business Proposal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: As payback for being fooled, Tae-moo sets a trap for Ha-ri at a company event. But when she drunkenly apologizes, he has a change of heart.

1.title: EN - Business Proposal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: When plans for a confession go awry, Tae-moo takes Ha-ri on a date by the sea disguised as a work trip. Cha Sung-hoon confronts a red-faced Young-seo.

meta.plot: This documentary series, made in partnership with Vox, explain some of the world's current trends, from politics, to science to pop culture.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Racial Wealth Gap
1.plot: Cory Booker and others discuss how slavery, housing discrimination and centuries of inequality have compounded to create a racial wealth gap.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Designer DNA
1.plot: Scientific feat or terrifying social experiment? Specialists in the field discuss the high stakes and ethical controversies of gene editing.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Monogamy
1.plot: What do biology, human history and the promiscuity of bonobos reveal about monogamy? Experts and everyday couples weigh in on shifting cultural norms.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - K-Pop
1.plot: Elaborate music videos, adoring fans, killer choreography. Learn about the global music phenomenon from South Korea that goes beyond "Gangnam Style."

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Cryptocurrency
1.plot: Cryptocurrency has made people billionaires, but is digital cash the next revolution? Learn about this anonymous currency and how it's coveted.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Why Diets Fail
1.plot: Atkins. Paleo. Keto. Do any work in the long term? Experts look at marketing, food environments and genes to explain why diets are often unsuccessful.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Stock Market
1.plot: Does the stock market accurately reflect the status of the economy? Finance specialists discuss market history, valuations and CEO incentives.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - eSports
1.plot: Is fake violence a sport? Fans, shoutcasters, and eSports icons break down today's video games and the explosive popularity of competitive gaming.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Extraterrestrial Life
1.plot: Despite decades of searching, we have yet to discover extraterrestrial life. Scientists discuss the reasons, including: Are aliens just too snobby?

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - !
1.plot: Do we overuse exclamation points!? Linguists and copy editors look at how the punctuation has adapted across history, literature and internet-speak.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Cricket
1.plot: Cricket experts look at how the confusing sport became so popular and discuss its evolution in becoming more accessible entertaining and profitable.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Weed
1.plot: Marijuana experts discuss the rise of potent "sexually frustrated" cannabis plants, the quests for consistency in weed strains and the history of hemp.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Tattoo
1.plot: They've been used to command respect, punish criminals and mark achievements. Tattooists speak about the origins of tattoo traditions and rituals.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Astrology
1.plot: Do zodiac signs prescribe your fate? Or do horoscopes' accuracy lie in the placebo effect? Take a look at the science, history and lure of astrology.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Can We Live Forever ?
1.plot: Can we uncover the secrets to extending the human lifespan? Experts discuss how developments in science -- even the French lilac -- hold some clues.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - The Female Orgasm
1.plot: The female orgasm is more elusive when a man is involved. Discover the reasons why and how women are embracing hands on solutions.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Political Correctness
1.plot: Political correctness can sometimes feel like a tug-of-war between inclusivity and free speech. Experts discuss the concepts behind the fraught term.

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Why Women Are Paid Less
1.plot: Hillary Clinton and Anne-Marie Slaughter discuss the cultural norms at the center of the worldwide gender pay gap, including the "motherhood penalty."

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - The World's Water Crisis
1.plot: The global water crisis is at an inflection point. How do we price our most valuable resource, while also ensuring access to it as a human right?

1.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Music
1.plot: When does sound become music? Why are humans so uniquely able to master musicality? Researchers talk rhythm, octaves and the magic of song and dance.

2.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - Cults
2.plot: How do cults lure people in and exert control? Learn a cult’s telltale signs, and how loneliness and life online makes indoctrination easier than ever.

2.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Billionaires
2.plot: There are more billionaires than ever. But how does this vast accumulation of wealth affect the world? Mark Cuban and Bernie Sanders offer insights.

2.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Animal Intelligence
2.plot: What goes on inside an animal's mind? Figuring out how they think and feel might just be the key to understanding our own place in the world.

2.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Athleisure
2.plot: It began with bloomers. Then came spandex. Now we sport leggings and other activewear everywhere. How did comfy, casual clothing go mainstream?

2.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Coding
2.plot: Computer code now controls how we live. But how did these programming languages evolve? And how can they be used to build a new and better world?

2.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Pirates
2.plot: In pop culture, pirates are often depicted as booty-looting rogues, but their history is far more complicated. See how they became enemies of humanity.

2.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - The Next Pandemic
2.plot: If you're not worried about a looming global pandemic, you probably should be. Are we prepared for an outbreak? Bill Gates and other experts weigh in.

2.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - The Future of Meat
2.plot: The planet's current rate of meat consumption is unprecedented -- and becoming unsustainable. In the future, will meat alternatives be the answer?

2.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - Beauty
2.plot: Beauty may be in the eye of the beholder, but what exactly makes things such as art and architecture aesthetically pleasing, and why do we like looking?

2.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - Diamonds
2.plot: A diamond is forever. But why is that? Dig into how these mined pieces of carbon became both a status symbol and a sparkly sign of everlasting love.

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E01 - Sugar
3.plot: Once crucial for survival, sugar now poses a health risk. Is there a way to satisfy our primeval craving for sweetness in a healthy, balanced way?

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - Royalty
3.plot: How do monarchies survive when they no longer wield power? By presenting a royal fairy tale that may not reflect the reality of the past — or present.

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E03 - Flags
3.plot: A flag can unite, divide and terrorize. Explore how a piece of cloth transformed into a powerful symbol of both love and hate, freedom and oppression.

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E04 - Dogs
3.plot: Who's a good dog? They all are! From puppy-dog eyes to feats of heroism, see how canines evolved into humankind's best friends and sources of pure love.

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E05 - The End of Oil
3.plot: Oil led to huge advancements - and vast inequities. As the planet warms, why is it so hard to turn away from fossil fuels, and can it be done in time?

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E06 - Chess
3.plot: For centuries, chess has captured hearts and minds — and pawns — and it's more popular than ever. What makes this ever-changing board game so special?

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E07 - Your Skin
3.plot: Don’t panic, but our skin plays host to trillions of bacteria, fungi, mites and other microscopic guests. Go beyond skin-deep with our largest organ.

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E08 - Apologies
3.plot: Apologizing is tough, and in this era of public mea culpas, forgiveness isn't guaranteed. What makes for a good apology, and why does it hold such power?

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E09 - Hurricanes
3.plot: As the planet warms, hurricanes could become even more dangerous and destructive.

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E10 - Plastic Surgery
3.plot: The Instagram face. A shapely posterior. Cosmetic surgery can make the latest beauty trends a reality. Explore its origins and effects, inside and out.

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E11 - Dance Crazes
3.plot: From the waltz to voguing, dance crazes have connected people throughout history. But when a dance catches on, who gets the credit — and compensation?

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E12 - Time
3.plot: Time flies… sometimes. Its passage can seem to speed up and slow down. Why do we experience time the way we do, and how do we take back some control?

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E13 - Country Music
3.plot: Dirt roads. Pickup trucks. Hip-hop? As the borders around country music shift, who decides what defines the popular genre, and who gets to be a star?

3.title: EN - Explained [MULTI-SUB] - S03E14 - Fairy Tales
3.plot: Fairy tales have survived thousands of years for a reason. Explore their far-flung history and how the stories speak to fundamental human concerns.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Hungry Christine; Mel Loves Ruby
1.plot: Roarke welcomes a local morning show host, Christine Collins, who has a simple fantasy: she wants to eat. And eat. And eat. But when Christine gets to Fantasy Island, she'll realize that she's hungry for much more than food. Roarke's other guests include Ruby Akuda who is afflicted with a terminal illness and is given a new lease on life.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - His and Hers; The Heartbreak Hotel
1.plot: Two adventurers, whose marriage has grown stale want to have the ultimate adventure together. Meanwhile, after sleeping for 35 years, widower Brent, must decide if he is ready to face his grief awake.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Quantum Entanglement
1.plot: Flamboyant, eccentric Eileen wants to spend time with her estranged daughter and her family, but they refuse to see her. Disillusioned physics professor Charles wants to know if there is something more out there.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Once Upon a Time in Havana
1.plot: Percussionist Alma wants to be accepted by her tight-knit Cuban family, but to understand why they disapprove of her musical career, she must revisit their history.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - The Big Five Oh
1.plot: When old friends Nettie, Camille and Margot come to the island to celebrate their 50th birthdays, their fantasies expose fault lines in their friendship.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - The Romance & the Bromance
1.plot: A bookworm who wants to say yes to life goes back in time to meet her favorite author, and a competitive survivalist learns that the ultimate challenge is something he hasn’t trained for.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Día del los Vivos
1.plot: A young artist Ramon wants to see his mentor, Jasper, again and Jasper realizes he may not have been the best influence on Ramon.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Welcome to the Snow Globe (1)
1.plot: A businesswoman's fantasy of a perfect Christmas and to meet "Mr. Right" tests Roarke in unexpected ways. Meanwhile, Mr. Jones faces his past, while a new Secret Santa tradition has Ruby and Javier looking to the future.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Welcome to the Snow Globe (2)
1.plot: A businesswoman's fantasy of a perfect Christmas and to meet "Mr. Right" tests Roarke in unexpected ways. Meanwhile, Mr. Jones faces his past, while a new Secret Santa tradition has Ruby and Javier looking to the future.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E01 - Tara and Jessica's High School Reunion; Cat Lady
2.plot: Longtime best friends, Tara and Jessica, want to rule their 30th High School Reunion, but their plans go sideways when everyone is forced to tell the truth. Andi wants to know if her cat BoBo loves her as much as she loves him. Roarke juggles a secret romance, as Ruby and Gina spend more time together.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E02 - Hurricane Helene; The Bachelor Party
2.plot: In the wake of her mother’s passing, Helene visits the island in search of her biological father. Roarke and Javier grow closer. Ruby gives herself a spiritual cleanse with a bonfire and a night swim, where she encounters an old friend.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E03 - Paymer vs. Paymer
2.plot: Empty nesters Dolly and Dutch seek clarity on how to spend their next chapter. Meanwhile, Helene helps Ruby tap into her newfound youth. Javier opens up to Roarke as he wrestles with his new role.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E04 - Mystery in Miami
2.plot: Three best friends set out to track down the missing fourth member of their squad... in 1980s Miami, Roarke confides in Segundo about letting people in, Ruby's cabin fever is an itch that needs to be scratched.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E05 - The Urn
2.plot: After an urn comes off the plane, three siblings must work through their past resentments in order to spread their mom's ashes and fulfill her last fantasy. As the kids wrestle with their past, Roarke remembers their mom, her very first guest as the host of Fantasy Island. Meanwhile, Ruby is surprised to discover how little she knows about Isla.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E06 - Forever and a Day
2.plot: Oliver's fantasy is to surprise his boyfriend Emilio with the perfect proposal, but when Emilio says no, Oliver finds himself reliving that day over and over again. Meanwhile, Roarke, also caught in the time loop, must confront her fears about her relationship with Javier.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E07 - #Happy
2.plot: Amber's fantasy is to have her actual life be as perfect as her Instagram life. But when Amber's family transforms into the perfect Insta-versions of themselves, she soon realizes something about all this perfection is very wrong. Meanwhile, Roarke presents another guest, Isaiah, with an envelope that reveals the date of his death.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E08 - Walk a Country Mile
2.plot: A country music star with writer's block, Shay, fantasizes about being anonymous so she can focus on finishing her next album. Her beleaguered assistant, Beau, is surprised when Roarke offers him a fantasy too. When their fantasies begin, Shay and Beau realize they've traded places: Shay is a complete unknown and Beau is the star. Javier learns something new about Helene's life before her mother's death.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E09 - Gwenivere of Glendale
2.plot: Gwen's fantasy is to go back in time and be the Princess she longs to be—pampered, rich, and cared-for. At first, the fantasy is everything she dreamed of—the gowns, the pageantry, everyone bowing to her. But Gwen soon finds out the King is preparing to marry her off to a cruel, ambitious Prince. With the marriage looming, Gwen has no choice but to flee. She befriends a Soldier and together they hatch a dangerous escape plan. Ruby isn't feeling like herself and Roarke suspects it has something to do with Isla.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E11 - Peaches & the Jilted Bride
2.plot: Jilted bride Laura arrives on the island still in her wedding dress, having just been stood up at the altar. She's never felt worse in her entire life, and her fantasy is to just feel better. The Island surprises her with her childhood imaginary friend, Peaches, in real human form and helps Laura rediscover that her inner child is exactly who she needs to move on from her heartache. Isla tells Ruby about the complicated past between her people and the Roarkes.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E12 - Girlboss, Interrupted
2.plot: The Island gives single mom Courtney the ability to read minds in order to impress her charismatic boss, Julia. But when Courtney becomes overwhelmed with her new power, she risks everything she has worked so hard for. Meanwhile, Roarke is worried that Ruby is becoming more and more distant and enlists Javier to help.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E12 - Girlboss, Interrupted
2.plot: The Island gives single mom Courtney the ability to read minds in order to impress her charismatic boss, Julia. But when Courtney becomes overwhelmed with her new power, she risks everything she has worked so hard for. Meanwhile, Roarke is worried that Ruby is becoming more and more distant and enlists Javier to help.

meta.plot: Sur une île paradisiaque, des vacanciers vivent un incroyable séjour. Les événements, qui ne se déroulent jamais comme prévu, les amènent à se remettre en question. Ils ignorent encore à quel point le voyage dans ce cadre magique va les transformer. Ces personnes de passage partagent leurs histoires émouvantes et leurs rêves. Intendante de cette île mystérieuse, Elena Roarke a mis de côté ses propres ambitions - et même l’amour de sa vie - pour préserver l’héritage de sa famille.

The ultimate battle royale for divinity has begun. High schoolers must use their unique powers to compete against each other for the coveted title “God.” But as each brawl becomes more vicious than the last, alliances are formed and betrayals take place. Who will emerge victorious and claim their godly throne?

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Unnoticed by Anyone, in the Place of Which Everyone Dreams
1.plot: Ono Goro, a young man with few friends and poor mental health, is appalled to find out he's not hallucinating when he's informed that he's acquired superhuman abilities and must battle others in a death game.

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Is He Strong, Is He Weak?
1.plot: Goro used his new karma-twisting powers to resurrect Honoka. The two of them form an alliance along with his friend and fellow God candidate Akitsu, and Honoka provides them with an explanation of some of the details of their new status as candidates.

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - You're the Finest of Friends
1.plot: Despite forming an alliance, Lall warns Goro to remain wary of Akitsu and Honoka. But Goro trusts his good friend Akitsu, in particular, and even when he steals his smartphone, Goro writes it off as just a prank. But when he finds him at their arcade...

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - What That Means Is, We're Kindred Spirits
1.plot: Honoka tells a depressed Goro about Little Angel, who can resolve any problem a person might have. Chika from the Science Club joins in the hunt, and they discover that Tatsuya is Little Angel. But Tatsuya is already the target of Koki the delinquent...

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - So Upright and Strong
1.plot: After a late-night SOS call from Chika, Goro heads to school. There he finds Koki fighting off a bunch of students wearing strange masks. Upon figuring out that "Little Angel" Tatsuya is a God candidate, Goro sets out with Koki and Chika to stop him.

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Form, Voice, Memories, and Even the Pain
1.plot: Goro accidentally bought two tickets for his favorite idol Iyo's concert, so he invites Koki along. After learning that Koki has become a KamiErabi God candidate in Tatsuya's place, Goro ends up running into Iyo in a men's bathroom just prior to the show.

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Close Your Eyes, Cover Your Ears, and Afterwards
1.plot: Honoka attempts to murder Goro, who's currently incapacitated due to the repeated use of his power. But after Koki and Lall hinder her, a frustrated Honoka encounters Chika while attempting to leave the hospital. Events then take a turn for the bizarre.

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Introductions Will Have to Wait
1.plot: During Goro's recovery celebration at the arcade, sexy actress Mitsuko suddenly climbs out of the TV. She asks for help rescuing her friend from a meddling God candidate named Keita. Meanwhile, Honoka tries to get info about other candidates from Chika.

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - If You Took a Trip, Where Would You Want to Go?
1.plot: Falsely branded as fugitives, Goro's group forms a new alliance with Honoka and Chika. They use Mitsuko's power to leap through space and escape Keita's attack, but a navigational blunder on Mitsuko's part leads them to a surprise acquaintance of Keita's.

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - It's Not Rain That's Falling
1.plot: Honoka, Koki, and Chika find themselves forced into a harrowing battle against Kyo. Goro and Iyo begin to question their own powers and the true significance of the KamiErabi. Iyo presses Lall for information, but she claims to not remember anything.

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Light Hasn't Reached Us Yet
1.plot: Kyo died young before a treatment could be found for his disease, but Ryo wished him back into being when she became a God candidate. Now Kyo has full control of the parallel worlds Ryo creates, and he asks Goro to help him establish a utopia for her.

1.title: EN - KamiErabi GOD.app [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - My Wish Belongs to Me
1.plot: Goro succeeds in stopping Kyo and Ryo, but the use of his power robs him of the relationships he's established with his fellow God candidates. Lall alone remains by his side, and Goro confronts his own past in order to recall his long-forgotten true wish.

meta.plot:
What is the true identity of the solitary Raven Consort?

The Raven Consort is a special consort living deep in the inner palace who, despite her title, does not perform nighttime duties for the emperor. Some who have seen her say she has the appearance of an old woman, while others describe her as a young girl. The Raven Consort's name is Shouxue. She has the ability to use mysterious arts and will accept any favor asked of her, whether it is to find something lost or to curse someone to death.

The current emperor, Gaojun, visits her one night to ask a favor. Their meeting exposes a secret that will turn history on its head...

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Jade Earring, Part 1
1.plot: The Raven Consort is a special consort who does not perform nighttime duties. Though she accepts all requests including death curses, exorcisms, and finding lost items, it is said that misfortune befalls those who meet her. Despite living in the inner palace, she is a mysterious entity nobody knows much about. The emperor Xia Gaojun enters Ye Ming Palace where the Raven Consort resides. There he encounters Liu Shouxue, a beautiful young girl dressed all in black.

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Jade Earring, Part 2
1.plot: At Gaojun's request, Shouxue investigates the ghost possessing the jade earring. The owner of the earring was Ban Yingnü. Ten years ago, she was suspected of poisoning the Third Consort and hanged herself. In order to discover the truth about her death, Shouxue heads to the wash house with her lady-in-waiting Jiu-Jiu where Ban Yingnü's personal attendant Su Hongqiao resides. However, Su Hongqiao is unable to speak to them as her tongue has been cut out.

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Whistle
1.plot: Huaniang, the high-ranking inner palace consort who lives at Yuanqian Palace, comes to Ye Ming Palace. She wants to know why her flower whistle will not blow. Flower whistles are hung from the eaves of buildings at the end of winter to mourn those who passed away the previous year. Allegedly the dead return on winds announcing the coming of spring to blow the whistles. Huaniang is concerned that her whistle has not blown since she lost her lover Ou Xuanyou. Shouxue complies with her request and attempts to summon the soul of Ou Xuanyou so she can speak to him.

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Skylark Princess
1.plot: The ghost of a skylark visits Shouxue, which leads to her hearing the tale of the Skylark Princess and her tragic death.

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Confidant
1.plot: Two ghosts from Gaoujun's past continue to haunt him, as Shouxue and the eunuch Wei Qing investigate the cause. The answer may lie in the depths of the red-light district...

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Summer King and the Winter King
1.plot: Shouxue searches the storehouse for the ghost's gemstone, while Gaojun investigates the Raven Consort's secrets.

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Glass Prayer
1.plot: Shouxue must solve the mystery of the ghost that appears beneath the willow tree, and the two ghosts that appear in the emperor's chambers.

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Blue Swallow
1.plot: Yi Siha, a eunuch serving Feiyan Palace, visits Ye Ming Palace. He has seen the ghost of a boy holding a blue swallow feather and asks Shouxue to help him. During her investigation, Shouxue comes across Yi Siha being caned by some older eunuchs. When she stops the punishment, Yi Siha's mentor Kang Lan trembles with fear. In Shouxue's eyes he saw a horrifying monster.

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Water's Voice
1.plot: Court lady An Huilan comes to make a request. She claims she can hear the voice of a dead consort coming from within the water. Xi Wanlin, the Magpie Consort during Yandi's reign, drowned herself in the lake on the day the emperor was to visit her. The voice within the water is allegedly hers. Huilan asks Shouxue to save Wanlin, but Shouxue realizes there is more to the story than what Huilan is telling her.

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Masked Man
1.plot: Gaojun uncharacteristically appears lonely. Though Shouxue is concerned, she is unable to ask why. Several days later, Gaojun visits Ye Ming Palace to show her a haunted mask. The ghost haunting the mask apparently responds to a type of foreign lute. The problem is solved when Gaojun is able to provide such a lute. Gaojun tries to leave, but he is stopped by Shouxue.

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Groundwork
1.plot: Xue Yuyong warns Shouxue against getting too close to Gaojun, and Shouxue sends Wen Ying to Quechao Palace to investigate the Magpie Consort.

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Siblings
1.plot: After confronting the Magpie Consort, Shouxue and Gaojun discover the shocking reason behind the mysterious events. Shouxue then learns of her relationship to the Owl through Niao Lian.

1.title: EN - Raven of the Inner Palace [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Xiangfu Incense
1.plot: Gaojun orders Wei Qing to investigate Xiao Yue, and he discovers he had an accomplice within the palace.

meta.plot: In February 2022, at the turn of Russia's invasion of Ukraine, therapist Lydia is trying to divorce her husband. Instead of following her daughter’s advice and fleeing the country, Lydia starts helping strangers, becoming a source of transport.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E01 - Outlaws
1.plot: When Robyn Loxley's life is turned upside down by a police shooting, she turns to her friends, from underground rappers to daring outlaws, to save her mother's life from John Prince and the Sheriff.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E02 - Beast
1.plot: After stealing Prince's car and saving her mother from the Sheriff, Robyn hopes the worst is behind her, until the Sheriff shows up in Sherwood under an umbrella of surveillance drones, using them to identify suspects and lock down the community.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E04 - Dope
1.plot: When John Prince bribes a pharmaceutical magnate to cut off Sherwood's medical supplies, he threatens Tressie's delicate health and drives Robyn and The Hood to a daring heist.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E05 - Rager
1.plot: When Chet Prince mistreats Alan's friend Elmore, Robyn and The Hood decide to crash his birthday party and steal from the richest playboy in town.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E06 - Peace
1.plot: Lionheart Day kicks off with a surprise as John Prince offers to bargain with Tressie over Sherwood's future; while Tressie and Prince negotiate, Robyn starts to suspect things are not what they seem when Guy Gisbourne returns to crash the party.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E07 - Joint
1.plot: The sheriff imprisons Robyn and her friends in a black site, determined to uncover The Hood by any means necessary; Prince pressures the mayor; Robyn puts her faith in a dowdy social worker who seems completely out of her depth.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E08 - Sieged
1.plot: With Prince's purchase of Sherwood complete, the Sheriff gives Robyn and her friends mere hours to evacuate; instead, Robyn joins forces with Tressie, Jill and her neighbors to make a final stand against the Sheriff.

meta.plot: Follows Robyn Loxley and anti-authoritarian masked hip-hop band, The Hood, as they call out injustices and fight for freedom and equality in the city of New Nottingham.

A gifted woman's intellect brings chance to lead covert European police force. But it backfires, costing her everything. Following murder at her home and kidnapped heiress, her ex-supervisor enlists a policeman's aid to reinstate her.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E01 - A Leap
1.plot: Antonia Scott is the most intelligent woman in the world –a virtue and a curse at the same time. Her intelligence allowed her to become the "Red Queen" of a secret experimental police project. But a personal tragedy removed her from active duty. Now, Jon Gutiérrez, a police officer in trouble, has to get her out of her seclusion to solve a case that will put her abilities and her past to the test.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E02 - A Tattoo
1.plot: Ezequiel has assassinated Álvaro Trueba and has kidnapped Carla Ortiz, both the firstborn of the most powerful families in Spain. Jon agrees to be Antonia's squire. Even though they started off with the wrong foot, they're about to catch Ezequiel after a fast-paced chase that has everyone on edge. In her cell, Carla finds out that she is not Ezequiel's only prisoner.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E03 - A Pill
1.plot: Antonia and Jon have barely started and they have already got the Kidnapping Unit, Ramón Ortiz, Laura Trueba and the shadow leader of Reina Roja, Mentor, against them. During the course of the investigation, everyone lies. Antonia and Jon realize that what Ezequiel has asked of Ortiz and Trueba is an admission of guilt. But Ezequiel is always one step ahead and now his threat looms over Antonia.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E04 - A Spanish Tortilla
1.plot: Antonia wakes up alone facing a mural. Why didn't Ezequiel kill her? The assassin wanted to deliver a message. A message that leads Antonia and Jon to a taxi car and to discover the true identity behind Ezequiel. The Kidnapping Unit has also found Ezequiel's address and taxi car, but Antonia notices that the pieces don't fit together as neatly...

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E05 - A Choice
1.plot: Antonia and Jon find out Ezequiel's daughter is helping him, but things don't add up. They have committed too many mistakes. But when the Kidnapping Unit falls into a trap, they realize they weren't mistakes. Carla discovers the truth about the kidnapped woman in the other cell. Jon makes a blunder that causes Mentor to close the case and remove Antonia from her position as the Spanish Red Queen.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E06 - A Disguise
1.plot: Antonia's father accuses her of kidnapping her own son and is about to get her arrested, but Jon helps her escape. Alone and with all the city police behind her, Antonia seeks to hide in order to think of a rescue plan for her child. With the help of her memories, her mind, her old friends... and a costume, Antonia is about to take on the most important mission of her life.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E07 - A Mirror
1.plot: Jon and Antonia get back together. The Queen and her squire have little time left and must go to underground tunnels riddled with traps and bombs. Sandra and Ezequiel are waiting for them and the lives of Jorge and Carla are at stake. But Antonia knows this is not over. Sandra is not who she says she is, but just a prophet of someone more powerful who already destroyed what Antonia loved most.

meta.plot: At the brink of going to hell, Yee-jae must cycle through twelve separate lives and twelve separate deaths in this reincarnation drama.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E01 - Death
1.plot: After enduring seven years of relentless job hunting and daily struggle, Yee-jae finally decides to end his own life. After death, he encounters a mysterious entity.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E02 - The Reason You're Going to Hell.
1.plot: Yee-jae doesn't understand why he's being punished and protests as he continues to face Death's retribution.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E03 - Death Can't Take Anything Away.
1.plot: As he continues to undergo Death's unpredictable trials, Yee-jae decides to take steps to prepare for his next life, unbeknownst to Death.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E04 - The Reason You're Afraid of Death.
1.plot: Death mocks humans, asserting that they desperately struggle to live only after they have died. In this life, Yee-jae reunites with someone he's missed dearly.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E05 - It Is Impossible to Break Free and Fight against Death.
1.plot: Death warns that it will intervene if Yee-jae ever attempts to kill someone, but Yee-jae dismisses the warning as he prepares his revenge.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E06 - Memory
1.plot: Yee-jae plans to accomplish what the world has failed to do, while Tae-u begins his counterattack.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E07 - Opportunity
1.plot: Yee-jae realizes that no matter how many times he's reborn, it's meaningless if he doesn't live as himself.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E08 - Don't Go Looking For Death. Death Will Come Find You.
1.plot: Just one final bullet remains. Will Yee-jae be able to evade death and survive?

meta.plot: Blanca Ferrando is a young woman who became blind at the age of twelve, due to a dramatic fire in which her older sister Beatrice died and which was caused by her violent boyfriend, Sebastian. This tragedy made her develop a very strong sense of justice to the point of pushing her to join the police. Blanca is helped by her most trusted friends: her guide dog Linneo, a female bulldog who protects and comforts her in the most difficult moments, and her beautician friend, Stella. After overcoming her work challenges, she finds herself facing sentimental ones: torn between two men, Inspector Michele Liguori, a man of many secrets, and Nanni, a young cook.

1.title: FR - Blanca - S01E01 - Eyeless
1.plot: The San Teodoro police station in Genoa is turned upside down by the arrival of Blanca, the new intern with blindness and incredible intuition.

1.title: FR - Blanca - S01E02 - Ghosts
1.plot: The body of a boy is found in an ancient noble palace that belongs to the family of Liguori, Blanca's charming colleague.

1.title: FR - Blanca - S01E03 - I dance by myself
1.plot: Just when Blanca tries to convince herself that she doesn't care about Liguori, having discovered his relationship with journalist Marinella, her son disappears.

1.title: FR - Blanca - S01E05 - Spots
1.plot: The disappearance of a young doctoral student in engineering reopens a loose end in Liguori's past and brings to the surface his conflicted relationship with his mother.

1.title: FR - Blanca - S01E06 - Going back home
1.plot: The new case Blanca is investigating interests her closely: it concerns Carmine Russo, the father of the boy she had indicated as her sister's murderer.
