3.title: FR - Creepshow - S03E01 - Mums / Queen Bee
3.plot: Jack’s life is upended when his mother is taken from him, but her garden leaves him more to remember her by than he first thought. Trenice and her friends are obsessed with pop star Regina. When they hear she has been admitted to a local hospital, they take the chance to try to meet Regina in person… but she’s even more larger-than-life than they imagined.

3.title: FR - Creepshow - S03E02 - Skeletons in the Closet / Familiar
3.plot: Lampini loves movies more than anything, and can’t wait to show off his prop collection to the world… but when a rival collector arrives, the machetes and chainsaws could become more than just props. A drunken visit to a psychic leaves Jackson on edge. As time goes on, he realizes he is being followed by a dark force… will the psychic’s advice help, or leave him worse off?

3.title: FR - Creepshow - S03E03 - The Last Tsuburaya / OK I'll Bite
3.plot: An art collector purchases the last painting from an artist famous for creating terrifying works, but he never anticipated the ways the painting would change his life. Life in prison is tough, and Elmer’s pet spiders make him an easy target on the cell block. Luckily, when Elmer reaches a breaking point, he knows at least his 8-legged friends will have his back.

3.title: FR - Creepshow - S03E04 - Stranger Sings / Meter Reader
3.plot: Barry can’t believe his luck when a cute girl invites him to her place for a drink, but he quickly learns he was duped by a siren and he’s in for way more than he bargained for. When a demonic pandemic strikes, a teenager fights to keep her family safe. But when she realizes they may have been infected, can she find the strength to fight the Devil’s plague?

3.title: FR - Creepshow - S03E05 - Time Out / The Things in Oakwood's Past
3.plot: Tim finds the answer to always wishing there were more hours in the day, but the success he can now achieve might not be worth the cost. The town of Oakwood has a storied past, and the opening of a time capsule is an exciting moment of remembrance. But can a local librarian keep a darker part of the town’s history from repeating itself?

3.title: FR - Creepshow - S03E06 - Drug Traffic / A Dead Girl Named Sue
3.plot: A young girl and her mother must cross the border to access life-saving medication. But when they get detained and can’t access her medicine, the symptoms are much more distressing than the guards originally thought they’d be. When the dead rise from their graves, it’s every man for himself… and the local townsfolk have some justice that they’d like to serve.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E01 - Twenty Minutes with Cassandra / Smile
4.plot: Cassie is being chased by a monster, and endangers a kind stranger when she asks for help- but what can they do? Then, a celebrated photographer is tormented after an award-winning photograph has more consequences than just fame.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E02 - The Hat / Grieving Process
4.plot: A horror novelist's agent offers him help overcoming his writer's block, and the struggling author can't resist. Then, Richard's wife is attacked and becomes a shell of the woman he loved. He'll do anything to help her feel better.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E03 - Parent Deathtrap / To Grandmother's House We Go
4.plot: Lyle is a disappointment, and when his parents meddle in his life and their plan backfires, he must deal with the aftermath. Then, Marcia takes her stepdaughter to her grandmother's house to claim their inheritance, and nothing can stand in her way.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E04 - Meet the Belaskos / Cheat Code
4.plot: The Belaskos get more than they bargained for when they move in next door to a vampire-hating suburbanite. A father and son bond by playing an old video game, but soon find out there’s a reason it was abandoned.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E05 - Something Burrowed, Something Blue / Doodles
4.plot: A young couple are gifted everything they could ever wish for... but there's a catch. Then, an aspiring comic artist keeps hitting roadblocks. As she doodles away her frustrations, she realizes she might have more power than she thinks.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E06 - George Romero in 3-D! / Baby Teeth
4.plot: A struggling bookstore owner finds unpublished works of George Romero, but the comics lead to new troubles. Shelby’s mom struggles to accept that her baby is growing up, but hanging on to childhood relics isn’t as harmless as she thinks.

meta.plot: A young boy's horror comic book comes to life in this anthology series of terrifying tales.

40-year old political leader Birgitte Nyborg secures her party a landslide victory through her idealism and huge effort, then faces the biggest challenge of her life: how most effectively to use the newly won seats, and how far she is willing to go in order to gain as much influence as possible.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E01 - Decency in the Middle
1.plot: Three days before an election, party leader Birgitte Nyborg shakes up her campaign by denouncing her closest ally, sensitive information about the prime minister's shopping expenses lands in the wrong hands, and the rising star of the evening news is shaken by an unexpected death.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E02 - Count to 90
1.plot: After a successful election, Birgitte Nyborg looks set to become Denmark's first female prime minister, but allies and opponents do their best to block her way.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E03 - The Art of the Possible
1.plot: A few months into her term the new prime minister faces her first political crisis, and journalist Katrine Fønsmark considers how to deal with her unexpected pregnancy.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E04 - 100 Days
1.plot: The revelation of an American prisoner transport in Greenland causes scandal upon the new government's first one hundred days in office.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E05 - Men Who Love Women
1.plot: The government's agenda on equal opportunities in corporate business brings pressure from the media as well as the country's most powerful businessman.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E06 - State Visit
1.plot: An official visit by the president of a former Soviet republic makes headlines when the president demands the arrest of a prominent political activist visiting Denmark at the same time.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E07 - See No Evil, Hear No Evil, Speak No Evil
1.plot: The discovery of illegal surveillance of a left-wing party brings into question the prime minister's friendship with the party's spokeswoman as well as her faith in her own minister of justice.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E08 - The Silly Season
1.plot: While the prime minister tries to take a family vacation, the publication of a tell-all by a former politician puts spin doctor Kasper Juul on the edge.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E09 - Divide and Rule
1.plot: Allegations of corruption in connection with military spending has consequences even for the prime minister's husband, who has accepted a new job.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E10 - The First Tuesday in October
1.plot: A year after taking office, the prime minister's approval ratings are low, her government is in internal conflict, and her marriage is hanging by a thread. As she prepares for another year in parliament, what can be saved?

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E01 - 89,000 Children
2.plot: A year has passed since we last saw Prime Minister Birgitte Nyborg. In the season opener, Birgitte is visiting soldiers stationed in Afghanistan when their encampment is attacked, and several soldiers are killed. Now she must choose: send the troops home or stage a counterattack?

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E02 - In Brussels No One Can Hear You Scream
2.plot: Prime Minister Birgitte Nyborg must appoint a new EU Commissioner. Sejro would seem the obvious choice, but Birgitte is surprised when he not only turns down the post but sees it as a personal slight. Who can she appoint?

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E03 - The Last Worker
2.plot: The coalition government is preparing to introduce a new reform package - "A Common Future". But attempts to get agreement on the reforms causes Labour leader Bjørn Marrot serious problems - in the media and within his own party.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E04 - Battle Ready
2.plot: Troels Höxenhaven exploits the hijack of a Danish ship by Somali pirates to try and raise his profile. However, compromising photos of Höxenhaven turn up at the Ekspres.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E05 - Plant a Tree
2.plot: Birgitte Nyborg is about to negotiate the environmental element of the new reform package, but she must face the reality of parties unwilling to compromise. Kasper convinces her that underhanded tactics can help win her a majority for the reform. Meanwhile, Katrine receives an unusual job offer that tests her personal beliefs. And at home, Birgitte's children are clearly affected by their mother's stress; Laura in particular.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E06 - Them and Us
2.plot: Kasper's past returns to haunt him as he clears out his parents former home, whilst the Freedom Party suggest lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 12. A move that reveals fundamental differences in the coalition parties.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E07 - What is Lost Inwardly Must Be Gained Outwardly (Part I)
2.plot: Birgitte's government is losing steam -- internal differences are growing and only compromise legislation is being passed. Just as opinion polls indicate Birgitte may lose the next election, financier Joachim Crohne emerges with an idea that could save her political career. But can his motives be trusted? Meanwhile, Kasper and Katrine are growing close again, but their jobs are at odds: Katrine's role is to uncover secrets, while Kasper's is to conceal them.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E08 - What is Lost Inwardly Must Be Gained Outwardly (Part II)
2.plot: The eyes of the world are on Copenhagen and Birgitte Nyborg as peace talks draw near between North and South Kharun. Everyone has been working around the clock, and although Kasper is now living with Katrine, they rarely see each other. When Birgitte realizes Denmark is only a small piece in a major international power game, her negotiation skills are put to the test. Can she end the bloody civil war?

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E09 - The Sanctity of Private Life
2.plot: Laura's illness has worsened over the past few months, and Birgitte now feels terrible about failing to recognize it. When Laura's psychiatrist suggests admitting her to a private psychiatric hospital, Birgitte and Phillip immediately agree. This move becomes problematic when Birgitte's own tax reforms force her to pay out of pocket for the hospital cost. At home, Birgitte and Phillip are rediscovering some of their lost love, despite Philip's continued relationship with Cecilie.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E10 - An Extraordinary Remark
2.plot: In the season finale, Birgitte is on a month leave from her post as prime minister to focus on family, and Hans-Christian Thorsen, Labor Party chairman, has positioned himself to be her possible successor. Birgitte is torn about whether or not she will return to work. Meanwhile, as Kasper and Katrine hunt for apartments together, their plan is derailed by an argument about the possibility of having children. Will one of them relent?

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E01 - A Child of Denmark
3.plot: Two and half years later, Birgitte is traveling the world out of politics when suddenly the changing Moderate Party makes her want to return. The problem is, Krause, whom she sent away to EU, is the leader of the party now, and does not want her back. Sojro however tells Birgitte to oust Krause as a leader. Birgitte hires Kathrine to help her, and they try to get the votes together so Birgitte could once again become the leader of the Moderate Party.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E02 - The Land is Built on Law
3.plot: Birgitte is keeping her plan to herself initially, but one by one she involves people. While some are enthusiastic, Sejro does not take the news well, even calling Birgitte a traitor. Meanwhile, Kathrine is struggling with the role of being a (working) mother.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E03 - The Right Shade of Brown
3.plot: Birgitte has attracted lots of followers to her party, but the policy has not been set yet and there is no money. A banker offers a donation of one million but is there a catch? Meanwhile the team is searching for a spokesperson on immigration to debate on TV and Kathrine struggles with her feelings for Kasper.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E04 - Their Loss…
3.plot: Birgitte struggles to get her party recognized particularly by other politicians, but might have a chance to change it when her boyfriend gets sick and is exposed by the media. Meanwhile, Kathrine continues to struggle with her feelings for Kasper who has difficult time understanding why her behavior has changed.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E05 - Thou Shalt Not Commit Adultery
3.plot: Being accepted as a political party, New Democrats must take a stand on a controversial issue of banning buying sex. Through learning about the issue both Birgitte and Kathrine face their prejudices and their views on the issue change as they get personally more involved. It also affects their personal relations.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E06 - Sons of the Past
3.plot: The ex-communist professor joins The New Democrats Party.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E07 - The Fall
3.plot: When the New Democrats are invited to join a broad coalition of opposition parties they think it is the recognition they have been seeking. But Birgitte soon finds she has no bargaining power whatsoever, much to Nete's disgust.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E08 - If You Never Change Your Mind
3.plot: Birgitte quickly realizes that the New Democrats are now minor players in the opposition coalition and she pulls them out of it. The Moderates seem to be proposing things that Birgitte has privately discussed - is there a mole?

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E09 - Sense and Sensibility
3.plot: After the leaks to the Moderates, Birgitte decides that the New Democrats need to distinguish themselves from the Moderates. So in a debate she launches a bold attack on their leader Jacob Kruse - will her strategy work?

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E10 - The Election
3.plot: Kruse's outburst in the pre-election debate proves fatal to the Moderates and the New Democrats pick up more than double the predicted seats. Suddenly, Birgitte is being courted by both the left and right wing coalition groups.

meta.plot: Mehdi, a qualified robber, and Liana, an apprentice thief, get involved in a turf war between drug dealers, and have to collaborate in order to save their loved ones.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Small-time hustlers Shaïnez and Liana land in hot water with a tough Brussels drug dealer after stealing from one of his men. Anissa asks Mehdi for help.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Mehdi and his men search for the missing drugs. Chris sends the Djeblis a warning. Impressed by Mehdi's skills, Saber blackmails him into taking a job.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: As they gear up for a risky heist, Mehdi and Liana's gangs join forces. Hassan confronts Saber. Coralie reveals a terrible family secret to Sofia.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: A furious Chris prepares to wage war on the Djeblis — and everyone else involved in the heist. Hassan sends Danique to cover Saber's tracks.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Mehdi tries to protect Anissa and Shaïnez. Fueled by revenge, Sofia underestimates what Chris is capable of. Liana acts carelessly.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: As the war with Chris reaches a boiling point, Mehdi and Tony seek vengeance while the Djeblis plan their next move against the Antwerp enemy.

meta.plot:
Kahina Zadi, 32, a French police officer travels to Kiruna in Sweden to investigate the bestial murder of a French citizen. Together with Anders, a Swedish prosecutor of Sami origin, she begins an investigation. Soon new killings start to happen and the first victim turns out to be the tip of a very dark iceberg. The victims seemingly have nothing in common more than that they are all being killed in a well-planned and vicious manner.

In their hunt for the truth, both Kahina and Anders are forced to deal with their own past that they have repressed. A personal journey through a painful past becomes the key to succeed in preventing the violent killings that affects the small mining community of Kiruna.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: The brutal murder of a French citizen sees French homicide investigator Kahina Zadi go to Kiruna, Sweden - a small town in the Arctic Circle where the sun doesn't set. Together with Rutger Burlin she begins an investigation that soon takes on staggering proportions.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Kahina Zadi and Anders Harnesk are desperately looking for a connection between the bestial murder of Frenchman Pierre Carnot and the helicopter pilot Kambo. On a notice board in a shop Anders happens to see a note with Kambo’s name and the number 20 on it. A note with Carnot’s name and the number 21 is also found. Anders and Kahina realise that this is just the beginning.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: It is clear that the horrific murders committed in Kiruna are part of a hit list. Three men are already dead, and when Anders studies the murder scenes more closely he finds evidence pointing towards the Sami. If this becomes public the small mining community might be torn apart by hatred and conflict. The autopsy report shows that Chief Prosecutor Burlin was poisoned with rare herbs. Shaken, Anders visits a shaman on the mountain to find out who could supply the herbs. Noaidi gives him a name.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Injured and exhausted, Kahina is held captive by the confused and intoxicated Bangkok Jori who admits that he sold the herbs that killed prosecutor Burlin. Back in Kiruna, Kahina is approached by a threatening Frenchman who demands that she keeps him informed about everything in the investigation. Kimmo and his miner colleagues all receive a video on their mobile phones that shocks them. Someone knows what they have done.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Anders receives information about another murder, and is becoming increasingly concerned about Kahina’s whereabouts. Waiting outside the police station is a young Frenchman who claims that he is Kahina’s son. Sparen considers going to the police to tell them everything he knows, but first he calls a meeting.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Anders and Kahina find unexpected and unpleasant links between the murder victims, and some of the residents of Kiruna. Kahina’s boss in Paris orders her to report her findings directly to the mysterious Frenchman. This is no longer an ordinary murder investigation, and Kahina begins to fear for her son’s life.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: What dark secrets did Sparen confide in the Sami girl Evelina? Kahina is determined to find Evelina’s body and sends divers down to the stream where she was last seen. The case was closed as a suicide, but there are too many clues in the investigation that lead back to her. In Eddie Geatkis’ abandoned house, Kahina and Anders find the last pieces of the puzzle in a horrific plan. But where’s Eddie?

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Eddie starts a fire in the depths of the mine, as Kahina races to stop his plan coming to fruition.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E01 - The Girl with the Big Suitcase
1.plot: Jacky's daughter arrives in Kaboul. She wants to do humanitarian work, but he wants her back on the plane...

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E02 - The Swimming Pool
1.plot: Jacky's fundamentalist neighbour is outraged by what's going on at the Kabul Kitchen and gets him embroiled in a long argument with the Afghan authorities. Sophie plans to open a school for girls.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E03 - The Panther & the Printer
1.plot: Jacky's having trouble sourcing alcohol. Relations with his regular suppliers are rather tense and he has serious doubts about the seemingly easy solution that Colonel Amanullah offers by way of help.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E04 - Dollars and Passion
1.plot: When Jacky is seduced by a customer, it may have serious financial consequences for the restaurant. Sophie contacts election candidate Hamida about opening her girls' school in a poor neighbourhood.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E05 - Fear in Kaboul
1.plot: When rockets hit Kabul and the restaurant is UN blacklisted, profits take a hit so Jacky hires some mercenaries. What could possibly go wrong? Sophie wants Axel's help with the girls' school campaign.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E06 - Vice and Verses
1.plot: Colonel Amanullah asks Jacky to hide his mistress Djamila when she is discovered by his wives, but Sophie objects to Djamila's confinement in her room. Then Jacky finds himself arrested for procuring.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E07 - Sophie's Departure
1.plot: Sophie wants to return to France after the opening of her girls' school gets no publicity and few pupils turn up. Jacky fears he has cancer, but is hesitant about being treated in an Afghan hospital.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E08 - White Lies Between Friends
1.plot: Amanullah is inspired to improve his media profile when BBC reporter Nigel, an associate of Jacky, turns up. But Jacky doesn't want a journalist uncovering his connection to the drug lord colonel.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E09 - Martine in Kaboul
1.plot: Outraged by Nigel's report, in which Jacky's lifestyle is exposed, Sophie's mother Martine rushes to Kabul to ask for the child support she never received and hires an Afghan lawyer to represent her.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E10 - Crisis of Faith
1.plot: When the daughter of Hakim, Kabul Kitchen's cook, leaves the country with help from a German NGO, he turns to religion and coaxes his workmates to adhere to strict Muslim precepts, threatening profits.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E11 - Cool in Kaboul
1.plot: On election day, Jacky threatens Amanullah over the Halli brothers' deaths. Sophie is delighted to get a job at Kabul's new humanitarian association. Westerners are threatened as riots shake the city.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E12 - Not Cool in Kaboul
1.plot: Jacky manages to get his customers evacuated from the bar - after they've paid, of course. Amanullah and Axel try to find Sophie, who's been kidnapped. Damien wants to send the riot photos to France.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E01 - Plague and Cholera
2.plot: After three months, Jacky finally 'escapes' his kidnappers, but is shocked to find a crumbling shell where Kabul Kitchen used to be and a landlord chasing unpaid rent. Can he make it a hotspot again?

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E02 - My Name Is Robert, Jacky Robert
2.plot: If Jacky's contract with the CIA seems too good to be true, that's because it is, which becomes clear when he's given his first assignment. Meanwhile, Sophie secures funding for a new sports stadium.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E03 - The Third Gulf War
2.plot: Sophie meets Amanullah's daughter Lala and admires her tenacity so much they decide to organise a female football team to help fund the stadium. CIA agent Harvey Stein is still giving Jacky headaches.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E04 - The Gangster of Kabul
2.plot: Stein arranges for a team of pole dancers to work at Kabul Kitchen as part of a plan to trap a corrupt UN official, landing Jacky in trouble with local brothel owners. Meanwhile, Sophie goes missing.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E05 - Don't Shoot the Barman
2.plot: When Damien's scoop poses a threat to the CIA, Jacky arranges for him to hide out at Habib's house while he leaks the story elsewhere. But Damien gains recompense via Habib, who has his own secrets.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E06 - The Ex-Woman of My Life
2.plot: When an ex-lover of Jacky's arrives on a diplomatic mission and insists on using Kabul Kitchen for a sensitive ministerial meeting, the CIA bug the place and Jacky struggles to balance his loyalties.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E07 - Top Secret
2.plot: Jacky finds himself working for the CIA and French secret service, who both insist on him wearing a wire to a meeting organised by Colonel Amanullah at his palace, but will he crack under pressure?

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E08 - The Locker Room of Fear
2.plot: On the day of the football final, Stein tells Jacky to inspect the contents of a briefcase in the locker room containing information relating to Amanullah's position, leading to a dangerous stand-off.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E09 - The Road to Jalalabad
2.plot: Under increasing pressure from the CIA, Jacky finds himself in need of a quick getaway, but escaping without a passport is tricky. Paul Braque has the right contacts, but wants something in return...

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E10 - The Man with the Pearl Pistol
2.plot: The CIA threaten Jacky with a one-way ticket to Guantanamo if he doesn't help with their investigation. Jacky must retrieve the murder weapon, an ivory-handled gun, but it's easier said than done.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E11 - The Traitor, the Brute and the Fiancee
2.plot: Amanullah is tipped off by a member of the Afghan police that they have the murder weapon and he's convinced one of his staff is responsible. Jacky is ordered to lure the colonel away from his palace.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E12 - Jacky Unchained
2.plot: Amanullah vows to kill Jacky for his betrayal, sending him a warning that he will have him murdered at 6pm. With help from Habib, Jacky arranges an escape route, but will his plan be short-lived?

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E01 - I'm Jacky
3.plot: Sophie has been running Kabul Kitchen on her own since she believes her father died fleeing Kabul. When the police call her to tell her that they have arrested her father, Sophie fails to fail. At the police station, however, it is not Jacky that she discovers, but Michel, a small worldly crook who becomes encrusted in Kabul Kitchen. Amanullah comes out of prison, ruined. He had time to think in his cell. And he has a big project for his country...

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E02 - Russians and roses
3.plot: Michel receives a visit from patibular Russians: he owes them a colossal sum of money. Accused, Michel offers his services to Victor, in charge of the humanitarian program "Roses against Opium", in the hope of discreetly diverting funds. Amanullah gathers his children to announce his great project: he will be the next president of Afghanistan! Lala collapsed. Axel meets Jamal, the colonel's disabled son and the naughty duckling of the brood.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E03 - Colonel Cash Cash
3.plot: Michel convinces Amanullah to get involved in the rose program: it's good for the image of the future president. Jamal, Amanullah's disabled son, takes over the heads of the rose perfume labs. Damien learns that Sophie is pregnant, which doesn't really please him as he embarks on his new business: an extreme bus for thrill-seeking tourists. Lala, determined to keep the family tradition alive, began to traffic in arms.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E04 - Chicks and men
3.plot: The humanitarian program is stalling. Michel has a bright idea: we must organize an "Afghanton" for the benefit of drug victims. For the com', Amanullah will burn his opium production live. Habib, propelled on stage against his will, sings and makes a hit. A true Machiavelli, Amanullah's son reveals his true face.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E05 - The nose
3.plot: Michel brings from France a world-famous nose, an old friend whom Amanullah will fall madly in love with. Michel discovers Jamal's true designs: the perfume lab financed by Europe is actually a heroin lab. To please Sophie, Damien agreed to let Lala accompany her on her excursions; but Lala secretly uses her expat bus to pass the roadblocks and ferry her weapons.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E06 - Bamboo Shot
3.plot: The NGO "The Bamboo's Solution", supported by Angelina Jolie, is likely to win grants at the expense of the rose programme. Michel uses all his talents to convince the representative of the European Commission to support the roses, in vain. The Russian mobsters lend a hand to Michel: they eliminate the European official. Lala's arms trade is uncovered. Damien understands that he was fooled. Jamal, the unloved son of the Amanullah clan, takes power. The colonel is thrown out into the street.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E07 - The speech at the UN
3.plot: Amanullah is invited to give a speech at the UN. Since burning his opium in front of the cameras, the repentant drug trafficker has been a star. Problem: Amanullah has been depressed at Kabul Kitchen since he was kicked out of his palace by his son. Habib, pushed by Michel who sees it as a possible source of income, joins the cast of the "Afghan Star", the "New Star" Afghan version. There he meets Pissenlit, an attractive competitor. It's love at first sight. Problem: The girl's father is a fearsome warlord.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E08 - Afghan therapy
3.plot: Amanullah leaves Kabul, covered in shame after crying in front of the world's cameras at the UN. He takes refuge in the Mountains of Logar, at the home of Monadjat, a "war lady", a long-time friend. Axel, against Lala's advice, decides to adopt Aklamash, a 12-year-old orphan who has been following him everywhere since they met. As for Michel, he was arrested by the anti-drug squad which forced him to work together to bring down Jamal's business. For Michel, it's an opportunity to get rid of the Russians by making them take the blame.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E09 - Afghan-led robbery
3.plot: Amanullah discovers that his son Jamal is about to sell his drug to Russians. That's one too many for the colonel. He takes Michel on board to storm the heroin convoy and destroy it. Damien decided to leave Kabul without telling Sophie, who is due to give birth shortly. But on the way to the airport, Axel needs him: Lala is in danger. They all end up at the place of the deal with the Russians. But they don't know that Michel has made a deal with the police, and nothing goes according to plan... Meanwhile, Habib, threatened by Pissenlit's father, flees with his dulcinea.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E10 - Sophie's choice
3.plot: The Russians force Sophie to hand Michel over to them against Damien's release. Amanullah and Lala, deprived of the army, steal a stockpile of weapons and a mysterious safe. Victor finds himself with an international arrest warrant on his back; Jamal's heroin trafficking fell on him. Amanullah learns that Sophie and Michel are in mortal danger. The whole little "family" of Kabul Kitchen board Damien's bus to fly to their rescue.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E11 - So spoke Amanullah
3.plot: The stolen safe contains a large amount of enriched liquid uranium. If they want to sell this precious cargo and pocket $100 million, they have to go to Kandahar. The epic continues towards the mountains. So here they are not only pursued by the Russians who want Michel back, but also by Yazad who wants his safe back, and by Pissenlit's father who wants his daughter back. Suddenly, Sophie has her first contractions... The bus must stop again.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E12 - Valiant Michel
3.plot: Sophie gives birth, with the help of Michel. But the Russians caught up with the bus. Michel, the one responsible for all their problems, sacrifices himself. The Russians are recovering the uranium and Michel. The latter owes his salvation to providence... and his talent. Back in Kabul, nothing will be the way it used to be: Sophie realizes that Afghanistan is not a country to raise a child, she leaves Kabul with her daughter. Damien himself, stays, preferring the party to his new responsibilities. Sophie entrusts the Kabul Kitchen to Michel. Axel and Lala split up. As for the colonel, he embarked on the presidential campaign.

meta.plot:
Kaboul Kitchen is a French comedy television series broadcast by Canal+. It was created by Marc Victor, Allan Mauduit and Jean-Patrick Benes. The series is based on the true story of Radio France Internationale journalist Marc Victor, who ran a restaurant for French expatriates in Kabul until 2008. The first series premiered on February 15, 2012 on Canal+ and ended on March 5, 2012. It set a ratings record for comedy series in the primetime slot on Canal+. A second series, which will have 12 episodes, has been commissioned.

The series depicts the life of French expatriate Jacky who runs the popular restaurant Kaboul Kitchen in Kabul, Afghanistan. His daughter Sophie, who he has not seen in 20 years, arrives to do humanitarian work, while he is interested only in making money.

The series won two Golden FIPA Awards at the 2012 Festival International de Programmes Audiovisuels: one for Best TV Series and one for Best TV Screenplay. It was screened at MIPTV and named fourth on The Hollywood Reporter's list of "MIPTV A-List Projects" for the most promising series screened at the event.

Desperate to deal with a chronic digestive problem, stand-up comedian Blanche Gardin decides to consult a naturopath, who explains that her self-mockery on stage is sending her brain a negative message about herself. Blanche accepts this diagnosis with the faith of a new convert, decides to give up humor and embarks on the road to personal development.

But his peaceful plans turn chaotic after meeting Haruo, an ex-conductor forming a boys choir to restore his name. Tenshi and others reluctantly join. Despite Haruo’s antics, they grow to love performing and aim to win the national contest!

1.plot: The boys choir doesn't have enough members to compete in the Kanto choir competition. Luckily, the principal has found two likely, if quirky, candidates. But it might not be so easy to get them to join the choir.

1.title: EN - KAWAGOE BOYS SING -Now or Never- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Dreaming of Andalusia
1.plot: Cardbocchi can't shake the feeling he's being watched. One day, on his way home, he feels like he's being followed, so he runs...straight into a group of delinquents! Meanwhile, Haruo is looking for new choir members. Again.

1.title: EN - KAWAGOE BOYS SING -Now or Never- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Comparing Heights
1.plot: The Hyuuga twins won't stop arguing with each other, even when it disrupts their classes. It's gotten so bad that they're at risk of having to repeat their first year of high school. Fortunately, the principal has a solution—join the boys choir!

1.plot: The principal has found an interesting video on NewTube. She has Rika and Haruo listen to it. Haruo decides that since the singers are more "yes" than "no," he needs to find them and add them to the choir. But the choir will have to catch them first!

1.plot: Now that the choir has ten members, it's time to get serious about entering the Kanto boys choir competition! The boys find out that last year's national winners are performing at a festival, so they go to check them out. Then they run into Maiden's dad!

1.plot: The choir heads into the mountains for a singing training camp, but when they arrive, they discover that the site they'd reserved is already being used by a rival school! Meanwhile, Haruo refuses to do anything but...look for kabocha squash?

1.title: EN - KAWAGOE BOYS SING -Now or Never- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Getaway
1.plot: It's time for the choir to start rehearsing in earnest, but the AC is broken and it's too hot to think. They move to somewhere cooler, and Rika gives them a song to hone their rhythm. Then, they're swept up in a series of inexplicable events!

1.title: EN - KAWAGOE BOYS SING -Now or Never- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Denen (Farmland)
1.plot: The choir is still reeling from the loss of one of their members, but they're determined to practice as hard as they can for the upcoming competition. Unfortunately, their parents aren't happy about the choir's late hours and they complain to the school!

1.title: EN - KAWAGOE BOYS SING -Now or Never- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Unknown Colors

1.title: EN - KAWAGOE BOYS SING -Now or Never- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Now Or Never

meta.plot: Whether at the office or at home, corporate drone Yuji Sano works all the time. So when his home PC flashes a message about him being summoned to another world, Yuji restarts his machine…only to find that he’s inadvertently accepted the summons! Now in a fantasy world far removed from paperwork and computers, Yuji has just one thing on his mind: waking up from what he thinks is a dream and getting back to the mountain of work he left behind! But this other world has other plans for Yuji, who quickly discovers his Monster Tamer character class allows him to befriend slimes! And thanks to their number, those slimes help him absorb so much magical knowledge that he gains a second character class in the blink of an eye! How will Yuji wield his power now that he’s the greatest sage the realm has ever known?! And what about all that paperwork?!

1.title: EN - My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I Wanted to Protect the Town
1.plot: What can a single Tamer do against an entire army of 10,000 monsters with just a wolf, a dryad and a handful of slimes?

1.title: EN - My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Trying Out a Party
1.plot: Yuji’s party members don’t have a high opinion of Tamers, but his tracking skills are too valuable to pass up. Maybe Yuji can change their minds once they see him in action.

1.title: EN - My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - I Meant Too Strong
1.plot: Yuji overdoes everything, even when he's trying not to. But when a dragon appears underneath the calamitous blue moon, the Tamer may be the only one who can prevent disaster.

1.title: EN - My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Truly Unusual Situations
1.plot: A dragon is a formidable opponent. That's precisely why Yuji needs to get up close and personal to fight it with... a dagger!?

1.title: EN - My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - That Cold Looked Troubling
1.plot: A hard freeze means a high demand for firewood. It's time for Yuji to use his overpowered skills for a more mundane purpose, especially since delicious food is involved!

1.title: EN - My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Infiltrating an Ominous Village
1.plot: The bad news? There's something sinister going on in that remote village. The good news? The cult stationed there has no idea Yuji is on to them.

1.title: EN - My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Assassins in Pursuit
1.plot: Yuuji has a price on his head and two assassins are after him. He could easily defeat them, but that would only make him a bigger target. This calls for a more unique approach.

1.title: EN - My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - We Got Some Monster Armor
1.plot: If Yuji wants quality armor, he’ll need quality materials. And that means hunting a rare monster.

1.title: EN - My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - We Fought a Fire Dragon
1.plot: Yuji must now protect the town from the kaiju-level threat of a rampaging Fire Dragon.

1.title: EN - My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Revelation Came True

1.plot: Yuji may be strong, but he can’t fight the enemy and defend all the towns at once. If he wants to win, he needs to place his trust in all the friends he made along the way.

meta.plot: His strength limited by the magical crest with which he was born, Mathias, the world's most powerful sage, decides reincarnation is necessary to become the strongest of all. Upon his rebirth as a young boy, Mathias is thrilled to discover he's been born with the optimal crest for magical combat on his first try! Unfortunately, the world he's been born into has abysmally poor standards when it comes to magic, and everyone thinks he's still marked for failure! Now it's up to Mathias to prove everyone wrong…world's strongest sage-style!

1.title: EN - The Strongest Sage With the Weakest Crest [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Strongest Sage Appears
1.plot: The young Matthias Hildesheimer heads for the capital to take the entrance exam at the academy. He dispatches a monster, enchants a sword, and passes the exam with flying colors. How does the bearer of the "Crest of Failure" have such power?

1.title: EN - The Strongest Sage With the Weakest Crest [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Strongest Sage Enters the Dungeon

1.plot: When two demons attack the city, Matthias outsources one to the girls while he fights the other in a weakened state. Can his sage's knowledge get them through the battle?

1.plot: While Mattias works on the barrier around the school, he sends Lurie and Alma to deal with demons appearing around it. But when a full horde of demons appears before the barrier is complete, can the students alone hold them off?

1.plot: Matthias and his team set out for the dungeon city of Melkia, where they learn that the resident adventurers are being offered up for slaughter at the whims of the local lord. Is it incompetent leadership... or more demon influence?

1.title: EN - The Strongest Sage With the Weakest Crest [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Strongest Sage Saves the City
1.plot: Matthias and his party defeated the assassins sent to attack them by the corrupt local lord and with the king's permission, they formulate a plan to capture the lord of the city!

1.title: EN - The Strongest Sage With the Weakest Crest [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Strongest Sage Fights a Duel
1.plot: The Radinia Alliance posses a device that will let Matthias track down the mastermind demon. But in order to enter the territory where the device lies, he must defeat a Rank S adventurer who might just give him a run for his money!

1.title: EN - The Strongest Sage With the Weakest Crest [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Strongest Sage Works With a Team
1.plot: Matthias and his party head for the city of Folkia, only to find it controlled by demons and in order to stop the demonic plot to use humans to create powerful destructive weapons, the team plans to free the city.

1.title: EN - The Strongest Sage With the Weakest Crest [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Strongest Sage Faces a Powerful Enemy
1.plot: At last, the agent behind the demon activity in Melkia and Folkia reveals himself... and the revelation fills even Matthias with terror. Can Alma and Lurie retrieve a powerful magical weapon before it's too late?

1.title: EN - The Strongest Sage With the Weakest Crest [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Strongest Sage Goes on a Journey Again

Alma and Rurii try to recover the magic sword made by Matthias, who lies in the treasure house of the royal capital, but the demons take the students of the school as hostages and the  get stuck... Can Matthias overcome this unprecedented predicament!?

meta.plot: Ryuto Kashima is the school's gloomy introvert, and he's got a crush on Runa Shirakawa, the popular girl. After losing a bet to classmates, he confesses his feelings to Runa one day. Shocked and secretly just as inexperienced as Ryuto, Runa agrees to date him. The relationship grows between two people who are as similar as they are different. Will their young love blossom? Time will tell!

1.title: EN - Our Dating Story: The Experienced You and the Inexperienced Me [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Our Confession Story: The Experienced You and The Inexperienced Me
1.plot: When quiet nerd Ryuto Kashima's friends force him to confess his feelings for popular girl Runa Shirakawa, his entire world is turned upside down when she actually agrees to date him.

1.plot: Runa volunteers for the culture festival pamphlet committee and invites Ryuto to join to advance "The Friendship Project" with Maria. While Runa and Maria disagree over design, Maria and Ryuto get carried away talking about their favorite streamers.

1.title: EN - Our Dating Story: The Experienced You and the Inexperienced Me [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Our Different Story: The Experienced You and the Inexperienced Me Go Different Ways

1.plot: Things have been tense between Ryuto and Runa since the culture festival. Ryuto plans to tell Maria they can't be friends anymore, but a shocking incident leads to a discovery that changes everything for Maria, Runa, and Ryuto.

1.plot: With her relationship with Maria repaired, Runa dreams of her family living together again. She sets up a surprise dinner for her parents on Christmas Eve that, sadly, does not go as planned. Depressed, Runa asks Ryuto to stay overnight and comfort her.

Now known as Hellsalem's Lot, it has become a place where another world beyond imagining is connected to our reality. The balance within this new world is protected by a secret society known as Libra. Leo, a journalist and photographer who arrives in the city, is unexpectedly recruited to join their ranks.

1.plot: While Zapp makes Leo's daytime job delivering pizzas a living hell, they spot a dry cleaning van that is more than it appears to be. When Leo is kidnapped, the rest of the Libra team must work together to rescue him from his captors.

1.plot: As Zapp's profligate lifestyle starts catching up with him, word comes in that a Blood Breed attack is coming to Hellsalem's Lot, but that someone outside of Libra is also involved. Black speaks to White about their relationship with Leo.

1.title: EN - Blood Blockade Battlefront [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Z's Longest Day (Part 2)
1.plot: While a crowd looks on, an airplane attempting to fly into Hellsalem's Lot carries Jugei's junior pupil--and the top half of the Blood Breed Libra was fighting! The King of Despair continues setting his plan in motion. The Libra team gains a new member.

meta.plot: When Saku took in a stray black cat, she never expected that he would become the equivalent of a housekeeping life partner. But Yukichi, a giant cat who towers over Saku, is not your ordinary feline. He takes great pride in his culinary skills, and a good sale at the supermarket always gets his whiskers twitching. Saku may not have her act together yet, but at least she has Yukichi!

1.title: EN - Dekiru Neko wa Kyoumo Yuuutsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Masterful Cat Is Depressed Again Today
1.plot: Saku Fukuzawa always brings a tasty lunch to work, but she swears she can't cook. In fact, she seems like kind of a mess for someone who's still single. Good thing she's the owner of Yukichi, a masterful who can cook and clean like nobody's business.

1.title: EN - Dekiru Neko wa Kyoumo Yuuutsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Masterful Cat Has Grown Big
1.plot: On that snowy night, Yukichi decided he would take care of the woman who saved him. Little did he know what he was getting himself into. Now, since Saku is freaking out that her superior might've met Yukichi in person, Yukichi silences her with alcohol.

1.title: EN - Dekiru Neko wa Kyoumo Yuuutsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Masterful Cat Is Good at Giving Care
1.plot: Yukichi is depressed again today, thinking about all the problems with his owner, Saku. How can an adult human who can't even separate trash make it through life? Doing this and that, Yukichi takes care of Saku's daily life.

1.title: EN - Dekiru Neko wa Kyoumo Yuuutsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - A Masterful Cat Goes to the Aquarium
1.plot: The day of the aquarium event finally arrives! Saku keeps telling Yukichi that it's not a date, but he seems to keep misunderstanding? Either way, she heads over to the aquarium and finds that Chief Orizuka has a little surprise with him!

1.title: EN - Dekiru Neko wa Kyoumo Yuuutsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - A Masterful Cat Also Goes to Birthday Parties
1.plot: Saku and Yukichi receive invitations to Yume's birthday party. Yukichi convinces Saku that it'll be completely fine to attend since it'll be a costume party. However, will Saku and Yukichi really be able to fool all the parents and children there?!

1.title: EN - Dekiru Neko wa Kyoumo Yuuutsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - A Masterful Cat Is Photogenic
1.plot: As the days get cooler, Saku wants to pull out their kotatsu. However, she had forgotten theirs had to be thrown out due to certain events. Later, Saku's mother starts bothering her for pictures of Yukichi which causes a great photography dilemma.

1.plot: Saku's coworkers bring up marriage, putting Saku into a panic. Would she be able to get married to someone while having Yukichi by her side?! What if the other person found out about his masterful skills? Her cat is too talented for her to get married!

meta.plot: The notorious Cecil Hotel grows in infamy when guest Elisa Lam vanishes. A dive into crime's darkest places.

1.plot: The once-grand Cecil Hotel provides a nightmarish backdrop for the disappearance of Elisa Lam. Her final footage in an elevator triggers a viral hunt.

meta.plot: After years of silence, Ted Bundy’s long-term girlfriend Elizabeth Kendall, her daughter Molly, and other survivors come forward for the first time in a docuseries that reframes Bundy’s crimes from a female perspective. The series reveals how Bundy’s pathological hatred of women collided with the culture wars and the feminist movement of the 1970s in one of the most infamous crime stories of our time.

1.title: EN - Ted Bundy: Falling for a Killer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Boy Meets Girl
1.plot: 1969-1974: Everything's possible. The women's movement takes root, Billie Jean King beats Bobby Riggs in tennis, and Mary Tyler Moore inspires single women. Shy, single mom Elizabeth Kendall strikes out on her own in Seattle, where she meets Ted, an aspiring lawyer. But darkness looms on the horizon. Female university students are disappearing, and Elizabeth's new boyfriend has a strange meltdown.

1.title: EN - Ted Bundy: Falling for a Killer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Falling
1.plot: 1974: Ted gets accepted into law school in Utah, but he refuses to ask Elizabeth to move down with him. Their relationship begins to fray and she blames herself. Meanwhile, female students continue to disappear throughout Washington state and a composite sketch of the suspect convinces campus cop Cheryl Martin that the disappearances may be linked.

1.title: EN - Ted Bundy: Falling for a Killer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Gone Girls
1.plot: 1974-1977: More disappearances follow Ted to Utah where he is at law school. Elizabeth tumbles down the rabbit hole of doubt, wondering whether or not her boyfriend is the culprit. For a while, police rule him out. After a kidnapping survivor identifies Ted as her attacker, however, he is arrested, thrusting Elizabeth even further into limbo.

1.title: EN - Ted Bundy: Falling for a Killer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Take Care of Yourself, Young Man
1.plot: 1978-1980: Ted escapes from prison and is in the wind. Elizabeth has bad dreams and big fears; gruesome news reports out of Florida point to his whereabouts. A collect call from a Pensacola jail brings her to her senses. The nation, however, is suddenly swept up in Bundy mania. Upwardly mobile poster boy or monster?

1.title: EN - Ted Bundy: Falling for a Killer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Collateral Damage
1.plot: 1980-1989: Sentenced to die, Ted professes his innocence. Elizabeth and her daughter try to move on and put this chapter of their lives behind them. Meanwhile, in a last ditch effort to save his own life, Ted starts confessing. His lawyer Polly Nelson is shaken to the core.

meta.plot: What happens after we die? This docuseries explores personal stories and research on near-death experiences, reincarnation and paranormal phenomena.

1.title: EN - Surviving Death [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Near-Death Experiences
1.plot: A doctor is found lifeless after going over a waterfall. Now she and others share their near-death experiences. Does consciousness expand after death?

1.title: EN - Surviving Death [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Mediums Part 1
1.plot: Poised between life and death, mediums promise a chance to commune with the departed. Can seekers cultivate that ability and find solace and healing?

1.title: EN - Surviving Death [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Mediums Part 2
1.plot: A medium leads a séance, deeply moving a student. Plaster casts of "spirit" hands -- physical manifestations of the dead -- are explored.

1.title: EN - Surviving Death [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Signs from the Dead
1.plot: A bird, a dancing light or a caress: Signs and messages from the dead happen all the time, mediums say. So the grieving look for ways to communicate.

1.title: EN - Surviving Death [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Seeing Dead People
1.plot: Can consciousness survive a body's demise? An investigator records eerie sounds at a historic spot, and a doctor discusses encounters with the dying.

1.title: EN - Surviving Death [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Reincarnation
1.plot: Vivid details and unshakeable confidence -- from a 5-year-old. A child psychiatrist studies cases of past-life memories, which occur around the world.

meta.plot: A 10-part documentary chronicling the untold story of Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls dynasty with rare, never-before-seen footage and sound from the 1997-98 championship season – plus over 100 interviews with famous figures and basketball’s biggest names.

1.plot: In the fall of 1997, Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls begin their quest to win a sixth NBA title in eight years. But "The Last Dance," as coach Phil Jackson called it, will be shadowed by tension with the club's front office.

1.title: EN - The Last Dance [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode II
1.plot: Michael Jordan is left to begin the 1997-98 season without his injured sidekick Scottie Pippen, whose contract dispute with the Bulls' front office reaches a fever pitch as the team gets off to one of the worst starts of its championship runs.

1.title: EN - The Last Dance [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode VI

1.title: EN - The Last Dance [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Episode VII
1.plot: As Michael Jordan pushes his teammates hard for a sixth NBA title, his intensity and hunger for basketball dominance is in stark contrast to his mindset in October 1993, when he stunned the world by walking away from the game.

1.title: EN - The Last Dance [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Episode VIII
1.plot: Michael Jordan would famously use even the smallest slight imaginable to motivate himself against an opponent. And when his NBA comeback in 1995 fell short in the playoffs, he worked harder than ever to return to form.

1.title: EN - The Last Dance [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Episode IX
1.plot: In May of 1998, nearly a year after Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls fought past Utah in the NBA Finals, their path to a sixth title only gets more challenging, as a brutal seven-game series against the Indiana Pacers decides the Eastern Conference.

1.title: EN - The Last Dance [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Episode X
1.plot: In June of 1998, Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls face the Utah Jazz in an NBA Finals rematch, looking for a sixth championship and a perfect ending for "The Last Dance."

The story of the Venezuelan Ilich Ramirez Sanchez known as "Carlos", who was, for almost twenty years, one of the most wanted terrorists in the world.

1.title: FR - Carlos - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Ilich Ramírez Sánchez, a Venezuelan-born militant who fought with the Palestinians in Jordan, commits a series of bombings in London. He then moves to Paris, where the PFLP (Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine) has assigned responsibility and command of its European branch to Michel Moukharbal, "Andre", a militant Lebanese. He coordinates several operations by activists from the Japanese Red Army, in particular the taking of hostages at the embassy of France in The Hague. When Andrew was arrested, the French agents of the DST begin to address Ilich, who adopts the nom de guerre Carlos. To escape arrest, Carlos kills three policemen. Then he then joins the South Yemen leader of the PFLP, Wadie Haddad, who gives him a mission of rare audacity...

1.title: FR - Carlos - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Heading up a group of six militants, consisting of leftist Revolutionary Cells of both German and Palestinian militants, Carlos takes over the OPEC building, holding hostage the ministers and their accompanying delegations. Although the terrorist is at the peak of his media fame, by releasing the ministers to Algiers airport in exchange for a large ransom, he fails in the mission entrusted to him by Wadie Haddad. This is the basis of a rupture between the two men with Carlos later becoming a mercenary in the service of the highest bidder. First Syria and then Iraq. He sets up his base on the other side of the Iron Curtain between Budapest and East Berlin under the protection of the Stasi...

1.title: FR - Carlos - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Carlos group, based in Budapest and protected by Syria, establishes ties with different customers interested in their particular expertise, such as Ceausescu's Romania and Libya. Carlos makes a fortune trafficking weapons and appears as a major figure in European terrorism. However, the fall of the Berlin Wall soon puts an end to this frantic activity. Carlos sees his supporters and his flexibility dramatically reduced. He finds refuge in Sudan, where he becomes a hunted man, being tracked by several secret services. Eventually the authorities in his home country arrest him and extradite him to France, where he must answer for his actions...

meta.plot: A troubled war veteran is assigned to protect a controversial politician who may be the target of a terror plot.

1.title: FR - Bodyguard - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Another terrorist attack raises the UK threat level to severe. Home secretary Julia Montague holds secret meetings with the director general of the security service, freezing out the police and her own minister of state for counter terrorism.

1.title: FR - Bodyguard - S01E04 - Episode 4

1.title: FR - Bodyguard - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Principal Protection Officer David Budd has made a major breakthrough in the investigation into the attack on the home secretary, but his enquiries have put him in mortal danger. With the clock ticking and no-one left who believes him, David attempts to prove his innocence. But the evidence against him begins to stack up.

1.title: FR - Spotless - S01E06 - Fallowfield
1.plot: Martin's past catches up to him; Jean finds an ally in new Detective Chief Inspector Squire; Julie receives a commission from an unexpected client.

1.title: FR - Spotless - S01E07 - Say What You See
1.plot: Jean hopes that DCI Squire can help him break his partnership with Nelson; Martin begins an ill-advised affair; Julie investigates Jean's secrets.

1.title: FR - Spotless - S01E08 - True Love Weighs
1.plot: Jean uses his skills to help Maureen through a personal tragedy; Victor learns Martin's secret; Maddy is intrigued by an online friendship; Nelson plans to kill Jean in the woods.

1.title: FR - Spotless - S01E09 - Rebound
1.plot: Jean wants things to return to normal, but Julie has other plans; Maddy's friendship with Steven leads to trouble; Martin makes a decision about Victor's fate.

1.title: FR - Spotless - S01E10 - To Victor, the Spoils
1.plot: Jean and Martin devise a scheme to have Nelson kill Victor; Julie makes plans to leave London; information comes to light about the death of Jean and Martin's father.
