meta.plot: Toronto’s only female private detective in the 1920s takes on the cases the police don’t want or can’t handle. From airplanes and booze running to American G-men, Communists and union busters, Frankie’s fearless sense of adventure gets her into all kinds of trouble, but she always manages to find her way out.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E01 - Mother of Pearl
1.plot: Frankie is forced to partner with an unlikely ally when she’s the number one suspect in a jewellery heist.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E02 - Ladies in Red
1.plot: Frankie and Trudy are hired by a factory owner to root out communists at his plant, but things soon take an explosive turn.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E03 - Summer in the City
1.plot: When a body turns up in the luggage of a young man, Frankie and Trudy must join forces with reporter Ernest Hemingway to clear his name.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E04 - Healing Hands
1.plot: When Trudy gives shelter to a faith-healing preacher’s daughter, she and Frankie find themselves investigating Toronto’s Jazz scene.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E05 - Out of Focus
1.plot: Frankie and Trudy go undercover in the glamorous world of film in order to solve a seemingly impossible murder on a silent movie set.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E06 - Whisper Sisters
1.plot: After a shooting injures the young son of a friend, Frankie and Trudy’s investigation leads them into the dangerous world of bootlegging.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E07 - Ties That Bind
1.plot: Mary recruits Frankie and Trudy to find a missing teacher, but their investigation leads them to family secrets, Chinatown and murder.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E08 - The Pilot
1.plot: A day off turns into a day at the office for Frankie and Trudie when the infant son of a charismatic aviator is kidnapped during an air show.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E09 - Ghosts
1.plot: The horrors of war haunt Frankie when the investigation of a soldier's murder reunites her with a friend left traumatized by his tour of duty.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E11 - Once Burnt Twice Spied
1.plot: When Frankie gets a mysterious call from a British spy, Mary discovers how she and Trudy met and how Drake Private Detectives was formed.

1.title: FR - Hinterland - S01E01 - Episode 1: Part 1
1.plot: On his first day on a new job DCI Tom Mathias investigates a blood soaked bathroom and the disappearance of 64 year old Helen Jenkins. The inquiry focuses on an old Children's home above the ravine spanned by the Devil's Bridge.

1.title: FR - Hinterland - S01E02 - Episode 1: Part 2
FR - Hinterland - S01E03 - Episode 2: Part 1
1.plot: At a remote farmhouse, sixty-nine year old Idris Williams is discovered bludgeoned to death, and the investigation into his murder reveals the mountain’s bloody past.

1.title: FR - Hinterland - S01E04 - Episode 2: Part 2

2.title: FR - Hinterland - S02E01 - Episode 1: Part 1
2.plot: Mathias is under pressure. His wife Meg has turned up in Aberystwyth and he's under investigation by the IPCC following the death of Mari Davies at the end of the last episode. When a bus driver is found shot dead on an isolated mountainside, the investigation provides a welcome escape.

2.title: FR - Hinterland - S02E02 - Episode 1: Part 2
FR - Hinterland - S02E03 - Episode 2: Part 1
2.plot: The murder of a local dignitary and barrister leads to the uncovering of a tragic story of love and loss fuelled by mistrust and suspicion in the depths of the Hinterland. Why were Nora and Daniel living such a secluded life? What has Mathias discovered in the garden? Will he find Daniel before Glyn Powell gets hold of him? The clock is ticking, but Mathias knows that the relationship between Branwen Powell and Daniel is key to uncovering the truth.

2.title: FR - Hinterland - S02E04 - Episode 2: Part 2
2.plot: The murder of a local dignitary and barrister leads to the uncovering of a tragic story. Why were Nora and Daniel living such a secluded life?

2.title: FR - Hinterland - S02E05 - Episode 3: Part 1
2.plot: The discovery of a body in a remote lake leads Mathias and the team to investigate the complicated private life of a teacher missing from a small rural school.

3.title: FR - Hinterland - S03E01 - Episode 1: Part 1
3.plot: DCI Tom Mathias and DI Mared Rhys are confronted by a family in grief and a community in shock when they investigate the violent death of a local minister.

3.title: FR - Hinterland - S03E02 - Episode 1: Part 2
3.plot: As the investigation into the murder of a local minister continues, the net tightens around the minister's daughter. And as the case is brought to a shattering close, Chief Superintendent Prosser is forced to confront an old foe.

3.title: FR - Hinterland - S03E03 - Episode 2: Part 1
3.plot: Laura Dean, a curator, is discovered in a shallow grave in remote woodland. Mathias and his team must delve into the young victim's life to unearth some shocking secrets. Meanwhile, Prosser - still reeling from the death of Iwan Thomas - calls on the help of retired Chief Inspector Robert Owen.

3.title: FR - Hinterland - S03E04 - Episode 2: Part 2
3.plot: With time running out, Mathias must solve the mystery of Laura Dean's death whilst trying not to get distracted by his personal problems.

meta.plot: Tom Mathias comes to Aberystwyth having abandoned his life in London. He's a brilliant but troubled man. Despite his faults he is an excellent detective, who knows that the key to solving the crime lies not in where you look for truth, but how you look.

After 17 years in captivity, Israeli soldiers Nimrode Klein, Uri Zach, and Amiel Ben Horin return home to the country that made them national icons. They work to overcome the trauma of torture and captivity while settling back into their interrupted family lives. Meanwhile, the military psychiatrist assigned to them finds discrepancies in the soldiers' testimonies, and launches an investigation to discover what they are hiding.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E01 - Homecoming
1.plot: The negotiations for the release of three Israeli soldiers has ended successfully, and after 17 years in captivity, Nimrod Klein, Uri Zach and Amiel Ben Chorin are coming home.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E02 - The Facility, part 1
1.plot: Nimrod and Uri are taken to an interrogation facility designed for released Israeli prisoners of war in the small town of Zichron Ya'akov.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E03 - The Facility, part 2
1.plot: Haim investigates Nimrod and Uri at the interrogation facility.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E04 - Letters From Mom
1.plot: Uri is depressed. He refuses to leave his bed. Nurit tries to talk to him, but he refuses to answer the phone.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E05 - Keep Your Soul
1.plot: At the funeral of Amiel Ben Horin, everybody is there but Yael feels all alone.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E06 - The Journal
1.plot: Nimrod appears on national TV and recounts his experiences during his 17 years in captivity.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E07 - A Picture from Captivity
1.plot: Talia and Nimrod enjoy time alone in their bedroom after the kids leave the house.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E08 - ...And They Return to Egypt
1.plot: Uri and Nimrod disappear, and their families are starting to get worried; the Klein family is finding a few joyous moments, precisely when Nimrod is not there.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E09 - Awake at Night
1.plot: Nimrod still suffers from nightmares, especially about the night he killed Amiel.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E10 - Unveiling of a Monument
1.plot: Talia makes Nimrod choose between a future with her or a life of misery.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E01 - Goodbye, Sweetie
2.plot: Uri and Nimrode try to push the Ministry of Defense into figuring out where Amiel is by exposing the CD they got from Ruth Shorer.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E02 - Happy Birthday
2.plot: Talia breaks down while Nimrode is out partying; Uri and Nurit try to bridge their gap; Yussuf and Abdullah head out to handle an arms deal.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E03 - Little Lies
2.plot: The past troubles Yussuf; Abdullah tries to recruit children to be martyrs; Uri shares the horrors of captivity with Nurit.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E04 - Blue
2.plot: The connection between Jamal and Amiel is revealed; Yussuf struggles with the consequences of the shooting and the pressure to execute an act of terrorism against Israel.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E05 - Platoon Secretary
2.plot: Iris and Haim discover new details in the investigation; a cat-and-mouse detective game develops between Haim and Ze'ev, who is busy training the talented Yinon.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E06 - Beaches
2.plot: Atar Shorer recruits Yinon; a new direction in Haim and Iris's investigation leads them to "Operation Judas."

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E07 - The Picture
2.plot: Haim Cohen orders Uri and Iris to investigate the picture of the man; Nimrod struggles with adapting to his new life.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E08 - Death of an Agent
2.plot: Yussuf is not pleased with Ismail's new bond with Abdullah; Talia and Dr. Ostrovsky go out on a date; Uri suffers from poor health and goes to see his doctor.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E09 - Mika's Boyfriend
2.plot: The mind games between Ze'ev and Haim continue as new details are exposed regarding Operation Judas and Yinon's true mission.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E10 - Halva
2.plot: Haim tries to extract more details on Operation Judas from Ze'ev; together they work on cracking the code that Atar and Jamal use to communicate.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E11 - Our Woman in Damascus
2.plot: Uri's health is deteriorating; Nimrode reveals another detail regarding what happened with Amiel; Nurit embarks on a mission behind enemy lines; Yussuf tries to avoid Abdullah.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E12 - The Hannibal Procedure
2.plot: The soldier's kidnapping affects everyone; Yinon goes through the final phase of preparations for Operation Judas; Hatzav is drafted to the army.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E13 - Operation Judah
2.plot: The soldier's kidnapping awakens feelings of guilt in Nimrode; Yael worries about the identity of the kidnapped soldier; Yinon puts his special training to use for Operation Judas.

2.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S02E14 - Prisoners of War
2.plot: Operation Judas is underway; Sheik Qassab pays Leila a visit; Amiel returns home; Haim has his doubts about the operation; Amiel faces the greatest conflict of his life.

meta.plot: Brothel owner, Margaret Wells, struggles to raise her daughters in London during the 18th century.

1.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Margaret Wells’s business comes under attack from a rival madam. As they risk losing everything, how much will Margaret and her daughters have to sacrifice to keep the brothel, and the Wells family afloat?

1.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: An old friend’s return could be a godsend if Margaret can tempt him to invest in her brothel. But when an opportunity arises which could damage Lydia’s reputation, Margaret’s thirst for revenge puts all her plans at risk.

1.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Lucy is promised to Lord Repton, but is she prepared for the experience that awaits her? Lydia’s retaliation against Margaret might prevent her move to Soho, when the Wells are met with a baying mob outside their new home.

1.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Margaret's debts mount in the face of Lydia's campaigns against her and Florence's religious tirades, while Charlotte helps to introduce Lucy to the highest echelons of society.

1.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Lord Fallon shows interest in Lucy - can she finally snare herself a keeper? Charlotte’s decision to leave Howard puts her in danger. To escape Lydia, Emily has to risk more than one life - will she take that chance?

1.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: When Howard offers to be Lucy’s keeper, Margaret is delighted, but Lucy’s reaction will bring all three Wells women into terrible danger. Lydia is out for revenge, but will she track Emily Lacey down?

1.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: The Wells are reeling after Howard’s death, and someone is sure to hang for his murder. Can Margaret keep all her girls safe? Emily is trapped by Lydia and fears for her life - will anyone find her before it’s too late?

1.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Emily’s escape pits Lydia and Cunliffe against one another - which of them can earn the Spartans’ trust? Margaret is in trouble, but to preserve her own life might cost another’s death. She’s faced with a terrible choice.

2.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: When an unyielding new Justice makes a surprise arrest, Margaret and Nancy must race to find witnesses to give evidence against Lydia Quigley. Could this finally be their chance to get Lydia to pay for her crimes?

2.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: While Charlotte struggles with horribly divided loyalties, the community gathers to share its grief. Tempers flare and the women rally against the injustice of the judiciary, with devastating consequences for Nancy.

2.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Margaret must focus on business but a visit to the Pleasure Gardens leads to an unexpected confrontation. Charlotte tries to secure a powerful ally and gain Margaret's approval, while Lucy falls under Fallon's spell.

2.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: With the doors to Golden Square barred by the authorities, Lydia must try every trick in the book to get back on top. Can Margaret and Nancy secure the witnesses they need before she once more gains powerful protectors?

2.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Lydia draws Charlotte deeper into her web, but should Charlotte compromise herself in the hope of catching Lydia red-handed? Lucy finds herself playing a dangerous game with Fallon which could have disastrous consequences.

2.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: Trapped inside Golden Square, Charlotte's future looks bleak -- unless she can convince Lydia of her loyalty; Lucy makes a terrible mistake; Margaret must risk everything to save both of her daughters.

2.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: Margaret’s family reel as they discover how dire her situation now is. Margaret awaits her fate while Charlotte desperately implores allies and enemies for help, but Lydia is contriving a way to end their feud for good.

2.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: The women galvanise themselves into taking action against Fallon, leaving Lucy in a difficult position. But will Lydia get away with what she has done, or will justice come knocking?

3.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: When Greek Street is attacked by new pimps in town, Charlotte Wells fights back with disastrous consequences. Can Charlotte protect her girls from the men who want to take over her business? Meanwhile, on a whim, Lucy goes into business with two recent arrivals to the London scene. But what does she really know about her new business partners?

3.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: With Charlotte’s brothel fire-damaged and all of her savings up in smoke, she is determined to retaliate – but the Wells women will need to be clever: The Pinchers are violent men. Lucy offers to help her sister in a way that also benefits her new business. Meanwhile, in Bedlam, Lydia and Kate dream of escape, Lydia’s sights set on a return to her old home.

3.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: All of Soho are gearing up for an illicit boxing party at Lady Fitz’s house – quite a statement for an aristocrat to make. But with Lydia out of Bedlam, Blayne back in England, and the Pinchers determined to seal a lucrative deal, there’s tension in the air. Just as the evening is taking off, an old friend’s arrival stokes long-held rivalries.

3.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: The disastrous events of the night before leave the whole town reeling. As more details are uncovered, suspicion starts to spread through Soho.

3.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: As Margaret turns her mind to revenge, her family wonder just how far she’ll go to get justice for those she loves. But with the clock ticking, can North and Lucy protect her from the law?

3.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: After the violent events of the previous day, can Margaret ensure her family’s safety and also protect Jonas’ interests? And as threats escalate, can Lucy and Elizabeth keep Golden Square within their grasp?

3.title: FR - Les Filles de joie - S03E07 - Episode 7
FR - Les Filles de joie - S03E08 - Episodes 8

meta.plot: A chance encounter leads two 30-somethings to remember 1998, the year their teenage hormones kicked in — and the internet changed their lives forever.

1.title: IT - Generation 56k - S01E01 - The Date
1.plot: Daniel finally clicks with a woman he met through a dating app, but she’s not who she seems. In 1998, an incident with a VHS tape lands him in hot water.

1.title: IT - Generation 56k - S01E02 - The Woodworm
1.plot: Ines questions Matilda on why she didn't disclose her identity. Mati and Daniel discover the Internet while doing a school paper together.

1.title: IT - Generation 56k - S01E03 - Research and Development
1.plot: Daniel continues his search for the mystery woman. Bruno tries to have "the talk" with his son. At a work event, Luca, Sandro and Daniel face a dilemma.

1.title: IT - Generation 56k - S01E04 - Fidelity
1.plot: Amid the wedding preparations, Mati agrees to meet Daniel again. Back in the past, Luca, Sandro and Daniel come up with an X-rated business idea.

1.title: IT - Generation 56k - S01E05 - The Gift
1.plot: A surprise wedding gift from her estranged dad forces Matilda to face a wound she's been nursing for years — as well as confront her feelings for Daniel.

1.title: IT - Generation 56k - S01E06 - Come mai
1.plot: In the ’90s, the inseparable trio kicks off their risky business. Daniel goes on a date with an old flame and ends up having a rather peculiar night.

1.title: IT - Generation 56k - S01E07 - Message in a Bottle
1.plot: Daniel comes up with a plan to buy the concert tickets for Ines. A message from the past proves to be a game changer for Mati and Daniel.

1.title: IT - Generation 56k - S01E08 - The Elevator
1.plot: The past and present come to a head when Matilda and Daniel get stuck in an elevator and a life-changing decision must be made.

meta.plot: When a brilliant drone engineer, Victoria, is taken hostage in her own home, a series of dangerous events are set into motion in this high octane thriller.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E01 - The Takeover
1.plot: This high-octane thriller follows the events leading up to a terror-attack in Scandinavia. Borgen's Birgitte Hjort Sørensen stars as Victoria, a brilliant drone engineer who is taken hostage by terrorists in her own home, while the Secret Services in Denmark and Sweden are fighting against the clock to prevent an attack.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E02 - First Mission
1.plot: Victoria wakes up confused, scared and with her hands tied on her back. Iyad shows her a live feed of her son, Oskar. If she doesn’t do what he asks her to, Oskar will be killed. Victoria sees no other way than to do what he tells her. Under heavy surveillance,Victoria and Iyad travel to Victoria’s workplace SparrowSat, a drone company in Stockholm. It’s time for Victoria to complete her first assignment for Iyad.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E03 - The Return
1.plot: In order to have full control of Victoria and start next phase of the plan, Iyad has taken Victoria hostage in her own home. They drive to the airport, to pick up her son, Oskar, who has returned from Paris unexpectedly. She introduces Iyad to Oskar as an old friend, who will stay with them for a few days. Back at the apartment, Iyad forces Victoria to show him how to control a drone, using the software for the flight controller that Victoria has developed.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E04 - A Chance
1.plot: The dead driver from Gothenburg harbour has several times earlier travelled on the same flights between Copenhagen and Stockholm as Victoria Rahbek, and Jesper is determined to question her. Under false pretences, he visits Victoria - against Eva’s orders. Eva is furious with Jesper and their collaboration hangs by a thread. Henrik cautions Jesper but keeps his promise and arranges a meeting between Jesper and a former source.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E05 - Recruited
1.plot: Victoria tests the flight controller. Its security system prevents it from flying over nofly zones. In order to make it fully functional, she needs a security code from her Swedish colleague Linda. PET and SÄPO now have Victoria under constant surveillance and in the Copenhagen airport Eva makes contact with Victoria. Victoria tells her that Iyad is keeping her and Oskar hostage and Eva promises to get them both out alive.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E06 - Double Agent
1.plot: As Eva and Jesper close in on Iyad’s terrorist cell, they force Victoria to act as a double agent. She is to act as if nothing has happened and continue to steal equipment from SparrowSat, while reporting back to Jesper and Eva about Iyad’s terrorist network. One misstep can have fatal consequences for Victoria and Oskar. Victoria continues to prepare the flight controller while discreetly trying to get as much information from Iyad about the terror plans as possible.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E07 - The Sacrifice
1.plot: Victoria manages to establish audio surveillance on Iyad’s phone. PET and SÄPO are now able to track everything he does. While Victoria once again travels to SparrowSat, Iyad stays at home with Oskar. A close bond is slowly growing between Iyad and Oskar , which worry Victoria. At SparrowSat Victoria gains access to the servers, and manages to transfer the drone software to an external hard drive. But her colleague Linda surprises her in the middle of the transfer.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E08 - Survival Skills
1.plot: Iyad contacts Al-Shishani, worried that Victoria isn’t able to complete the task. PET and SÄPO also question Victoria’s mental health. They need to work fast if they don’t want to lose her. With an imminent attack planed to happen within two days, Eva and Jesper continue to map out the possible terror targets. But suddenly and without warning, Iyad leads Victoria and Oskar to his car and drives off to an unknown destination.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E10 - A New World
1.plot: SÄPO and the PET are on high alert. Both police authorities locally and nationally have been activated and the military is on standby. They know where the attack is planned to happen, and everyone is working feverishly to locate Victoria and Iyad. Al-Shishani, Iyad, Victoria, Oskar and Claes have escaped Copenhagen and arrive at their final destination; a desolate Swedish country house. They gather in the control room where Victoria sees the drone for the first time. She has more adjustments left before the drone can take off with the warhead and fly towards the target. While she hesitantly prepares the drone, Jesper and Eva desperately try to find the terrorists before it’s too late.

meta.plot: Follow controversial slimming cream sellers turned con artists Wanna Marchi and Stefania Nobile, from their TV success to their scam and jail time.

1.title: IT - Fortune Seller: A TV Scam [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E01 - Tummy Melter
1.plot: She came from nothing and married young. With a cheating husband and no money to her name, Marchi has to get creative to support her family.

1.title: IT - Fortune Seller: A TV Scam [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E02 - Devils
1.plot: Her shop was burned. Her daughter was threatened. But with some help, Marchi rebuilds her empire. However, allegations of unsavory practices swirled.

1.title: IT - Fortune Seller: A TV Scam [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E03 - Magician
1.plot: Marchi is now selling fortune itself, and people believe her — until some journalists look to expose her. But is there more to the investigation

1.title: IT - Fortune Seller: A TV Scam [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E04 - Evil
1.plot: The empire crumbles and Marchi is arrested for fraud and extortion. The trial becomes a national spectacle as victims testify about the hurt she caused.

1.plot: While chasing his family's roots in Ireland, Conan endeavors to speak like a local, sing with The Irish Tenors, and act on a long-running soap opera.

2.plot: Conan picks olives with Jordan Schlansky, tries his hand in a flight simulator and takes in the best of Madrid with Javier Bardem.

meta.plot: A typical morning. The usual music. Their normal lives. The peace these seven girls experience will suddenly be destroyed. By the living dead... zombies. A reality that they never wanted a part of, an amazing and terrifying zombie world. They all share one wish: "We want to live." These girls will struggle through this saga, in order to achieve a miracle.

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Good Morning SAGA
1.plot: Minamoto Sakura is starting her second year of high school with a song in her heart and a head full of dreams! Can she really become a glittering idol on stage? Are her nights of living as a normal high school girl coming to an end?

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - I <3 HIP HOP SAGA
1.plot: It's the dawn of a new life as Sakura meets the rest of her idol unit! But can they overcome their differences in personalities and come together to as a team?

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - DEAD OR LIVE SAGA
1.plot: On the day of their first guerrilla show, Sakura and the girls have barely had any time to rehearse, and Junko and Ai aren't sure about joining in. Will they be able to set aside their differences and capture the hearts of the passing pedestrians?

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Warming Dead SAGA
1.plot: Franchouchou is headed to the land of Ureshino in Saga to do perform for a big company! Will they be able to win over a new business partner with their singing and dancing?

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Nice Bird SAGA in Your Heart
1.plot: After the trouble at the hot springs, the girls get an opportunity to promote a local legend. After they fail to chicken out, their next gig involves a train to Kashima to steal a muddy spotlight.

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Because It's Sentimental SAGA
1.plot: Just when Franchouchou's efforts finally starting to attract some attention, a disagreement leads to Ai versus Junko in a battle of idol ideology.

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - But It's Zombiemental SAGA
1.plot: The time has come for Franchouchou to take the stage at the Saga Rock musical festival! But clouds are starting to gather, with the thunder and lightning causing Ai to freeze up in fear. Who will help re-animate her so that the show can be a success?

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Go Go Neverland SAGA
1.plot: With Franchouchou gaining more notoriety from Saga Rock, the girls luck finally seems to be turning around. But they're in for a surprise: it's the return of the living dad when Lily's father spots her on TV!

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Though My Life May Have Ended Once by Some Twist of Fate I Have Risen, and If Song and Dance Are to Be My Fate, Then Carrying the Memories of My Comrades in My Heart as I Sally Forth Shall Be My SAGA
1.plot: It's been a long time since Saki used to fight an army of rival bikers in the darkness, but an unexpected encounter with the family of an old friend draws her into back into the kind of rough scene that could be anathema to her idol activities.

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - NO ZOMBIE NO IDOL SAGA
1.plot: The girls of Franchouchou are going to have a dedicated concert! With a crowd capacity of five hundred! And Kotaro's plan to get them ready is... training in the mountains? Will his braindead idea pay off?

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - A One-of-a-Kind SAGA
1.plot: Sakura's amnesia is gone, and the results are unexpected. Will she be able to reconcile her new grim outlook on life in time for Franchouchou's big show, or is she doomed to be wasting away emotionally?

1.title: EN - Zombie Land SAGA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Good Morning Again SAGA
1.plot: The day of the Arpino show has come, and the other members of Franchouchou have made it clear to Sakura that they're not going to quarantine her because of her bad luck. But with a blizzard brewing, will the girls' undying loyalty to their friend prove to be their undoing?

meta.plot: After saving humanity from the despicable Demon King, Leo Demonhart does not earn a hero’s standing. Instead, he is regarded with suspicion and hostility by those he fought to protect. Treated as a pariah with nowhere else to turn, exiled Leo seeks a position in the army of his former nemesis! But the army is not what it once was before its defeat at Leo’s hands, so to maintain his new position, Leo must whip the forces back into fighting shape.

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - My Next Interview's at the Demon Queen's Palace!
1.plot: Rarely does a hero apply for a job with the Demon Queen. He has the skills, but he’s the one who defeated her army. Maybe he can clarify matters during his interview?

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Strive to Ease the Burden on Your Future Self!
1.plot: Shutina is a model employee, but she’s overworked, overwhelmed and stressed out. If he can stop irritating her for five minutes, Leo can help her delegate and avoid burnout.

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Little Bit of Thought Goes A Long Way for Efficiency!
1.plot: Whose idea was it to put Lily in charge of logistics? Why are her proposals drawn up in crayon!? It’s up to Leo to give her a training and development course on teamwork.

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Drinking Party From Hell
1.plot: There are certain rules one must follow when the boss invites an employee out for food and drinks. Especially when said employee is concealing his true identity.

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - If You Want to Quit, Talk It Out First
1.plot: There’s nothing wrong with quitting a job if it’s not a good fit. But one must make sure that it’s the best move for them and not something they’ll eventually regret.

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Hero Shares His Tale of Burden
1.plot: Listening is a vital part of communication, and Mernes is perceptive enough to know that Leo is holding something back. So the former hero confides his secret to the assassin.

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - A Good Warrior Isn't Always A Good Boss
1.plot: Edvard is a good warrior, but that doesn’t mean he’s a good leader. Especially when he thinks his troops aren’t trying hard enough when they fail at tasks he can accomplish.

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Tokyo, 2060 A.D.
1.plot: People are more than their jobs. Long ago, an unexpected friendship set Leo on the path he walks to this day.

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - I Want to Quit Heroing
1.plot: Time is running out for demonkind. Leo may have a solution, but that means revealing his identity to Echidna.

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - I'll Save the World, Even If That Means Destroying It
1.plot: The only ones who can save the world from the hero are the Demon Queen and her four generals!

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - What Makes a Hero
1.plot: Leo is a grave threat to the world, and no one understands that better than the former hero himself.

1.title: EN - I'm Quitting Heroing [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - I'm Quitting Heroing
1.plot: In the end, what does it mean to be a hero?

meta.plot: On the front lines of the war, Tanya Degurechaff, blond hair, blue eyes, and porcelain white skin, commands her squad with lisping voice. Actually, she is one of Japan's most elite salary men, reborn as a little girl into a world of magical warfare after angering a mysterious being who calls himself God.

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Devil of the Rhine
1.plot: The Empire is a powerful military nation on a continent that looks much like early 20th century Europe. But in this world, magic is real. The Empire is involved in a war against the Entente Alliance, and fighting a poorly executed delaying action in the northern theater. Second Lieutenant Tanya Degurechaff leads a small platoon of mages. But there's something unusual about this lieutenant... she's only nine years old!

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Prologue
1.plot: The secret of Tanya's birth is revealed. Tanya was a cold and unemotional Japanese salaryman who was pushed in front of a train by a man he laid off. An infuriated godlike creature named "Being X" sent him to this world, and reincarnated him as a baby girl... with no promise that he would ever be reincarnated again. Now Tanya has to survive, because this is all she's got!

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Deus Vult
1.plot: After her stunning success with her first mission, Tanya is assigned to test a new piece of technology: a highly unstable prototype calculation jewel. This jewel offers her unparalleled power, but just using it risks her life. Tanya is determined to get out of this project and on to someplace easier and safer (like the front lines of the war), but Being X has other ideas...

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Campus Life
1.plot: Tanya is now living life on easy street, as a highly-respected student at the military university. She's so highly respected, in fact, that one of the Empire's chief military planners asks her for her opinion on the course of the war. Eager to show off her intellect (and hopefully land herself a cushy job in the planning department), Tanya comes up with a plan of astonishing insight and intelligence. Her idea backfires, however, when she turns out to be a little too smart for her own good...

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - My First Battalion
1.plot: Tanya's new battalion is off the ground and running, and it's time for them to do their first mission: fight back a massive invasion by the Dakian Dukedom to the southeast. The enemy army numbers in the hundreds of thousands, but they've brought no air units at all, which makes them easy pickings for Tanya's highly trained force. After wiping out the enemy army, she heads straight for the enemy capital and launches an attack there.

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Beginning of Madness
1.plot: After her easy victory over Dakia, it's time for a more difficult mission: aiding the destruction of the Entente Alliance to the north. The Alliance is being backed by the strong powers, and has equipment and training that in some cases rival the Empire. When Tanya arrives, the Alliance is striking a critical supply base with a bombing raid, and the local Empire force are too overwhlemed to defend against it. Can she get there to hold them off in time?

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Battle of the Fjord
1.plot: The Empire is launching a seemingly foolish attack on the Entente Alliance in the middle of winter. They lack the supplies to successfully invade. Tanya realizes that this attack is a feint intended to distract from a fjord landing mission. Sure enough, she is sent to lead the invasion of the fjords, and silence 20 cannon emplacements in time for the fleet to land and the Imperial forces to disembark.

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Trial by Fire
1.plot: The war with the Entente Alliance is done, and it's back to the Rhine for Tanya and her forces. The Republic troops are highly trained, well-equipped, and stronger than any she's faced before. And in a distant hospital, a former Kingdom officer wakes up, with a mission from God imprinted on his mind...

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Preparations for Advance
1.plot: The last enemy on the continent is the Republic, and the Empire has come up with a bold plan to take them out. Of course, Tanya is sent to the forefront of this operation, and is forced to take on the entire Republic army by herself while the Empire stages a faked withdrawl. Then it's off for a ride on a rocket as she heads straight into the heart of enemy territory!

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Path to Victory
1.plot: Tanya's spectacular mission is a success, and the Republic is surrounded and crippled. But on her way back, she runs into a group of allied mages, lead by Anton Souix, the man she crippled once more. He's back, and powered by Being X, and his one mission in life is to take down the Devil of the Rhine!

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Resistance
1.plot: Tanya's diminished smaller company attack the battalion of Allied Kingdom mages rather than retreat. Their company use their altitude advantage but suffer heavy losses, especially when Colonel Sioux uses an illegal Trench Gun.

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - How to Use a Victory
1.plot: Tanya just barely manages to restrain herself from disobeying her superior officers and attacking the Republic remanents. But the Republic forces have escaped overseas, and vowed to fight to the bitter end. The Empire has been victorious, but in its victory it has terrified the rest of the world and spurred them to action. Is true victory possible at all?

1.title: EN - Saga of Tanya the Evil [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 -

meta.plot: Sand Land is a mysterious world where demons and humans eke out an existence in a barren desert wasteland. In hopes of replenishing their water supply, Fiend Prince Beelzebub, a demon named Thief, and a human named Sheriff Rao team up and embark on a journey in search of the Legendary Spring.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP1: Departure
1.plot: A human, Sheriff Rao, Fiend Prince Beelzebub, and Thief, a demon, search for the Legendary Spring.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP2: The Royal Army's Secret
1.plot: The trio steals a Royal Army tank and winds up in a battle with a Royal Army airplane.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP3: A Man Called Legend
1.plot: As Rao's tragic past is revealed, the trio begins to battle General Are and his Royal Army Tanks.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP4: Beyond the Sandstorm
1.plot: When the Swimmers suddenly attack, Beelzebub gives chase and discovers something astonishing.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP5: The Terrifying Insect Men
1.plot: The trio arrive at the King's water source and the final battle with Supreme Commander Zeu begins.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP6: The Fiend Beelzebub
1.plot: An enraged Beelzebub overwhelms the Insect Men as Rao infiltrates the Army's mega aircraft carrier.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP1: On to a New Adventure
1.plot: The river flows once again in Sand Land, bringing with it new encounters and a new adventure.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP2: Operation: Sneak into the Capital!
1.plot: Upon learning of King Jam's imminent execution, the trio and their new friend rush to stop it.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP3: Fiend Power
1.plot: King Jam's execution is imminent once again when Supreme Commander Bred and Muniel corner Beelzebub.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP4: Muniel's Urn
1.plot: A hint from Lango leads the four to Demon Village where King Lucifer and Muniel square off.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP5: Flying Fortress Garam
1.plot: With the Flying Fortress Garam airborne once again, the four will do whatever it takes to stop it.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP6: The Final Battle!
1.plot: Beelzebub and Ann manage to get past Bred to stop Garam, only to come face-to-face with Muniel.

1.title: EN - SAND LAND: THE SERIES [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP7: The Battle Comes to an End
1.plot: The final battle, demon versus angel, comes to an end.

meta.plot: In the bustling heart of Shibuya, four young women—an artist, a retired idol, a V-tuber, and a composer—form JELEE, an anonymous artist group. United in their quest for self-expression, they journey towards self-discovery and finding their voice.

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Jellyfish in the Night
1.plot: Mahiru was an artist once, but she lost her spark when her friends ridiculed her art. However, a chance encounter with an anonymous singer could reignite her passion.

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Mei the Fangirl
1.plot: Kano was someone else once, a fact Mei knows all too well. When the composer finally sees the former idol again, all she feels is disappointment.

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Kiui Watase
1.plot: Mahiru asks a VTuber friend for help, and, on the surface, Kiui radiates the same confidence as the superheroes she adores. But she's hiding something beneath her digital mask.

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Double A-Side
1.plot: JELEE celebrates viewer response to their new video, but it doesn't take long before differences of opinion form while working on their next project.

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Viewer Comments
1.plot: Their music video went viral but not in the way they expected. They now have more fans, but Mahiru’s confidence is shattered after reading a comment criticizing her art.

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - 31 (Thirty-One)
1.plot: JELEE receives a commission request from an idol who dreams of becoming famous, but her secrets mean the situation is more complicated than the group ever imagined.

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Daybreak
1.plot: Now in their final year of high school, they must all decide what comes next and what their futures hold.

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Covert Gig
1.plot: JELEE’s first anniversary is coming up and they want to mark the occasion with something truly special. But their plan is threatened when a YTuber deduces Kano’s identity.

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Take a Look at Reality
1.plot: Kano's mother offers Mahiru a life-altering opportunity; the kind that launches careers. But it may clash with JELEE's plans. And there’s the matter of Kano's reaction...

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Idolized
1.plot: JELEE is on the brink of collapse, and it falls upon Mei and Kiui to pick up the pieces and ensure the group doesn't disband for good.

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - What I Love
1.plot: JELEE may have emerged intact, but Mahiru struggles to meet Yukine’s requested revisions. With the deadline hanging over her head, she and Kiui look back on an old art class.

1.title: EN - Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - JELEE
1.plot: Yukine invites JELEE to perform with the Sunflower Dolls at Mahiru’s request. Now, Kano must not only find her reason to sing, but overcome the demons from her past.

meta.plot: A melodramatic chase thriller that tells the story of special reporter Seo Jeong-won and detective Kim Tae-heon tracking down a murder case.

1.title: FR - Nothing Uncovered  [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Jung Won, as a reporter, excels at uncovering the guilty ones, and not only that, she possesses beauty and is married to a wealthy man. However, everything takes a dramatic turn when she encounters a dead body. To compound matters, a woman she barely knows alleges an affair with Jung Won's husband. The once-perfect facade of Jung Won's life begins to fracture further.

1.title: FR - Nothing Uncovered  [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Jung Won can't seem to shake off the startling scene she unexpectedly encountered, prompting her to keep quiet about what she witnessed. She meticulously sifts through Woo Jae's belongings in search of anything dubious, yet comes up empty-handed. Nonetheless, the temporary relief fades quickly, and her suspicions about Woo Jae resurface. Meanwhile, Tae Heon stumbles upon a shocking discovery while reviewing security footage for a separate murder case.

1.title: FR - Nothing Uncovered  [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Woo Jae rejects any involvement in Cha Eun Sae’s death and asserts that he is not the father of her unborn child. He also brings up during the investigation that Eun Sae had a sugar daddy who had been looking after her. Meanwhile, Jung Won focuses on Cha Geum Sae, Eun Sae’s brother, as the main suspect and investigates him further.

1.title: FR - Nothing Uncovered  [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: As Tae Heon unveils an evidence envelope containing a necklace, Jung Won is seized by overwhelming dread, her breath catching in her throat. She comes to the chilling realization that she is now under suspicion for the death of the woman entangled in an affair with her husband. Adding to her distress is the possibility of another woman deeply embedded in Woo Jae's life. Bewildered and frightened, Jung Won struggles to comprehend the gravity of the situation.

1.title: FR - Nothing Uncovered  [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: In a startling revelation, Jung Won uncovers that it was none other than Yoo Yoon Young who guided her to the scene of the murder. Meanwhile, Tae Heon meticulously pursues leads to unveil the culprit behind Cha Eun Sae's death. Jung Won delves into unlawfully recorded counseling sessions, unveiling the enigmatic persona of Lee Na Ri. As the truth becomes increasingly elusive with every turn, Jung Won ventures to Mueon City.

1.title: FR - Nothing Uncovered  [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: At Mueon High School, Jung Won uncovers crucial information about Lee Na Ri, potentially linking the factory fire, Jin Myung Sook, Cha Eun Sae, and Mo Hyung Taek. Meanwhile, Tae Heon learns that Yoo Yoon Young’s car was captured by a speeding camera in Owol-dong on the day of the murder.

1.title: FR - Nothing Uncovered  [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Upon confirming Yoon Young's alibi, Tae Heon hits a dead end, forcing him to reevaluate the investigation from scratch. Meanwhile, Woo Jae learns about Tae Heon and Jung Won's former romantic involvement and cautions Tae Heon against revisiting it. Jung Won, following an unpleasant three-way session involving Woo Jae and Yoon Young, realizes she's being followed.

1.title: FR - Nothing Uncovered  [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: She feels her existence is in serious jeopardy when Jung Won is kidnapped by an unidentified individual. The man's objective is to obtain her confession, specifically admitting to being the murderer. Meanwhile, while Yoon Young is asleep in a drunken state, Woo Jae investigates her belongings and discovers a photograph of Jung Won's necklace saved on one of her USB drives.

Nanakusa is a vampire. That's okay with human Ko. He wants to be one too. But transformation doesn't come that easily...

When Nazuna invites Ko to spend the night at her place in an abandoned building, he's stoked! But then he awakens to kisses on his neck with a little too much bite to them... Is it just the delicious taste of his blood that makes her meet him night after night for late-night adventures, conversation and...naps? Or something else? Then, when a cute girl from Yamori's past shows up and competes for his attention, his budding relationship with the undead is put to the test!

meta.plot: La Commune est un quartier difficile qui détient tous les records en matière de chômage, trafic de stupéfiants et criminalité. Après 20 ans passés en prison, le charismatique chef musulman Isham Amadi décide de réintégrer son quartier d'origine où il retrouve son ami d'enfance, devenu le caïd local, Housmane Daoud. Les habitants de la Commune viennent d'apprendre que les immeubles vétustes dans lesquels ils résident seront rasés pour faire place à de nouveaux logements. Soupçonnant là une manœuvre des autorités pour nettoyer la cité de ses éléments les plus « nocifs », certains habitants, rassemblés autour d'Amadi, organisent la résistance. Mais derrière cet affrontement politico-médiatique se profile une guerre de territoire larvée et meurtrière : celle que se livrent les deux frères ennemis Daoud et Amadi, liés par un crime vieux de vingt ans...

meta.plot: The story begins when Berry, an average girl from an average home, meets Hack, a girl who looks like a boy. Charmed by Hack, Berry meets up with the team Hack leads, the Ghost Detectives Club. Members of this club are “socially dead,” working invisibly within the digitally controlled society of Tom Sawyer. As she works with the group, Berry learns about Zero, a mysterious figure who lurks within Tom Sawyer’s underground. She and Hack decide to chase down this figure, and in time, the truth behind the city is revealed...

1.title: EN - YUREI DECO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Adventures in Tom Sawyer
1.plot: Berry is a girl living in the data-managed city of Tom Sawyer Island. Her hobby at the moment is trying to catch Phantom Zero, who's believed to be behind the cases of Love loss known as the Zero Phenomenon. One day, when she heads into town to get the broken Deco in one of her eyes fixed, Berry runs into a kid who seems like a ghost, due to being unable to be seen with Deco. Suspecting she may have finally found the Phantom, Berry begins her chase.

1.title: EN - YUREI DECO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Mysterious Stranger
1.plot: Berry and Hack are somehow able to escape from the Hyperverse that Phantom Zero pulled them into. But before long, Hack is apprehended by the customer center, who are investigating the Zero Phenomenon. The next day, Berry wakes up on the veranda of her apartment, and after trying to explain what happened, her friends point out to her that there is no evidence of Zero Phenomenon having occurred, much less of the kid she encountered. Not taking no for an answer, Berry decides to dig up proof behind the Zero Phenomenon.

1.title: EN - YUREI DECO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Sham Trial
1.plot: Hack is being held at the customer center under suspicion of being Phantom Zero, where she's questioned about the crime of forcibly erasing Love. Meanwhile, Berry learns from the mysterious Finn about how he and his comrades are ghosts, citizens who live in the city despite not being registered. Finn is skeptical that a fellow ghost would have helped Berry, and obtains the data on Phantom Zero from the paper plane device of Hack's that Berry brought.

1.title: EN - YUREI DECO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Yurei Detective Club
1.plot: Four months have passed since the trial. Berry is now a ghost herself, and has joined the detective club alongside Hack and her friends. They're trying to capture Phantom Zero, and discover the truth behind the Zero Phenomenon. And that's when a certain client approaches them. This man wants them to find his missing daughter. But after a bit of digging, it turns out the missing girl isn't his daughter, but the female avatar that he had been using. Not only that, but the timing of the disappearance seems to have something to do with when Berry and Hack were caught in a Zero Phenomenon incident.

1.title: EN - YUREI DECO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - On the Trail of a Liar
1.plot: The Ghost Detective Club has a new case. The client is a professor that uses Deco overlays to create artificial animal that he has on display at his Neo Animal Museum. His self-proclaimed masterpiece, the Nue, has an appearance that doesn't match the listing on Decopeedia, and hires the detective club hoping to clear up the confusion. After getting a glimpse at the professor's Nue, it looks nothing like the cute creature whose picture is on the Decopedia page. Even so, the professor insists that his Nue is the accurate version.

1.title: EN - YUREI DECO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Smiley and the Flying Lost One
1.plot: A new client has arrived. This time it's an AI drone, named Doron, that Smiley dug out of a garbage pile. With it's memory missing, it asks the club to find it's missing owner. After examining Doron, it becomes apparent that Doron is an illegal drone that isn't registered with the customer center. And on top of that, the only camera data still in their files appears to be of an avatar that is fighting against Phantom Zero.

1.title: EN - YUREI DECO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Inhuman Cart
1.plot: Berry catches wind of a ramen cart that nobody knows the location of. In order to find it, Watson begins checking rumors from all across the island. Berry suggests that the detective club search for the cart, but the other members aren't interested. As Berry and Watson investigate the rumors, Watson receives a tip on the location of the cart. In pursuit of ramen, Hack, Berry, and Watson set out to find it.

1.title: EN - YUREI DECO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Reach for the Heavens!
1.plot: Berry is helping Hank sort through the junk that he has salvaged at the harbor when they encounter an old friend of Hank's, named Will, who informs them about an older model of satellite that's expected to crash down into the nearby sea. Back at the agency, the peacock feather-like circuit that Watson received from Analytica is being analyzed. When Hank returns, he insists that they all head to the area Will tipped them off about.

1.title: EN - YUREI DECO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Burning Brand
1.plot: When Finn was young, his family lived in a slum where garbage tended to be dumped. One day, his brother brings him an older model of Deco that should be easier for Finn to use due to his Deco-Sickness. With it, Finn accidentally discovers that the local purification systems are broken. Believing this is what has caused his home to become polluted, he uses the Deco that he got from his brother to request that the customer center fix the purification system. But because he isn't registered as a citizen, his login is flagged as illegal, which leads to his request not being answered.

1.title: EN - YUREI DECO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - 2 Fathoms to Heaven?
1.plot: After being suspected of being Phantom Zero, Berry and the club use Deco disguises in order to escape. Meanwhile, the customer center is in a frenzy, thanks to reports of Phantom Zero that they're receiving from all over the place. They dispatch a search team to the slums. Finn and the detective club take shelter in one of Finn's secret hideouts, with Finn stating the only way they can clear their names is to head to the mysterious location known as Mark Twain, and apprehend the true Phantom Zero.

1.title: EN - YUREI DECO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Fate Changes Twice
1.plot: Thanks to Doron and his drone friends, Berry, Hack, and Finn are able to reach Mark Twain, a strange facility floating in the sky. By using the Angelfish club card they had previously obtained, they manage to get inside, where Berry and Hack enter Mark Twain's rendition of the Hyperverse. What they discover appears to be a labyrinth. Knowing that all the secrets of Tom Sawyer island must be contained within, Berry and Hack start searching for Phantom Zero's identity.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E02 - Hunting Accident
1.plot: Reno runs a bully (Pete Koch) out of a small town, but the man spots Reno's picture on a wanted poster and informs the police of his whereabouts.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E03 - Final Judgement
1.plot: Reno races the police to capture a hired killer in order to determine if the man has information on Reno's case--and to stop him from murdering a judge.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E04 - La Mala Sombra
1.plot: Reno takes on a group of Salvadorian assassins.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E05 - Mother Courage
1.plot: Reno is sent out to find the man who killed Jimmy, a motorcycle mechanic and finds himself in a small desert town. The town is run by a rich businessman who even has the local lawn under his control. Reno finds a biker club and infiltrates to find his killer.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E06 - Second Chance
1.plot: Lou Delgado, a real estate con man, is arrested then bailed out by her girlfriend, Jeanette. Lou decides to cut his losses and leave town, only to end up being a witness to a shooting.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E07 - Eye of the Storm
1.plot: In the middle of a huge storm, Reno stops at a seemingly deserted diner in a small town, but the place is taken hostage by escaped prisoners with a grudge to settle with the diner owner, who sold them out in prison.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E08 - Payback
1.plot: Two bloodthirsty killers shoot an informant friend of Reno's and give Reno himself a savage beating that leaves him hospitalized. Reno goes undercover at the ranch where one of the duo's ex-wife works, to try and get a lead on the pair, determined to get even.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E09 - The Talisman
1.plot: Reno is close to capturing a vicious killer, when he encounters a feisty teenage girl, who is after the man herself after he murdered her FBI agent father. Reno reluctantly joins forces with the girl, but her hot-headedness jeopardizes the whole case.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E10 - Partners
1.plot: After reading in the Newspaper about the trgic death of his ex-mentor/partner Reno seeks information as to what had caused his ex-partners death.He is informed by one policeman that an infamous drug dealer was responsible.The drug dealer one Jesus Ortega had escaped to Mexico.Reno accompanied by Bobby heads for Mexico for two purposes: Justice,and Revenge.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E11 - Lyons' Roar
1.plot: Reno sets out to bring in Earl Lyons, a former comrade from Reno's Army Ranger days, who now is addicted to morphine and has gone insane, living in the wilderness. Reno must stop Lyons before either the trigger-happy authorities, or drug runners whom Lyons double-crossed, get to him first.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E12 - Val's Song
1.plot: A bullet that was meant for Reno critically injured his girlfriend Valerie instead. After spending months in coma, she is finally released from her suffering. The criminal lieutenant Donald "Dutch" Dixon places a trap for Reno: He lets spreads the news that Valerie is healed.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E13 - Give and Take
1.plot: Reno helps a woman with a flat tire in the desert. Soon after that the woman is found dead in her home.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E14 - Samurai
1.plot: Reno Raines is about to arrest the gangster franc sand when he becomes a witness, as a small Japanese girl is kidnapped.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E15 - The Two Renos
1.plot: Lieutenant Dixon and Frank Bickford think of a plan to finally capture Reno: They release a criminal Tommy, who looks just like Reno.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E16 - Billy
1.plot: Reno is to snatch in a the gangster Dad Meecham and his three sons. While a brawl in the Saloon the sons become arrested, Meecham however can escape.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E17 - Headcase
1.plot: Joe Cortez had sworn revenge with his arrest. He breaks out of prison and procures himself weapons and money.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E18 - The Hot Tip
1.plot: Reno is to bring Amber Dane, a Hollywood Starlet, before court. Reason: Amber allegedly killed her friend five years before .

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E19 - Moody River
1.plot: Reno helps out a man being attacked in the middle of the road. The man takes Reno home with him to Second Chance Farms: a place where ex-criminals who want to begin a new life are able to work.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E20 - Vanished
1.plot: The daughter of Reno's loyal long-time friend Assistant D. A. Wells begins going on a downhill spiral, entering a life of drug addiction. Upon further investigation, Reno and Cheyenne discover there is much more to this family tragedy than originally thought. They soon uncover a rather elaborate scheme involving black market drugs, a touring rock band, and a corrupt band manager who plans to use the girl to leverage Wells into dropping the impending case against her brother, a notorious drug dealer.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E21 - Fighting Cage (1)
1.plot: Reno receives a video tape as proof that his estranged brother Mitch is still alive, despite being declared dead in Vietnam by the military many years prior. The video tape depicts Mitch competing in a rather sketchy underground cage fighting tournament. Reno decides to enter this strange underground world and investigate his brother's disappearance by posing as one of the fighters. He soon discovers that his brother has been brainwashed, and rescuing him from this dangerous and barbaric lifestyle will not be quite as easy as he once thought.

1.title: FR - Le Rebelle - S01E22 - Fighting Cage (2)
1.plot: After having some success in the preliminary rounds of the tournament, Reno begins to make some progress with helping his brother Mitch regain his memory. This becomes easier once he slowly starts having flashbacks of childhood memories of the two. Eventually Mitch joins Reno's side. The two bring down the entire cage fighting circus and those who conduct it, with the help of Bobby Sixkiller and a special task force.

meta.plot: Once rivals in school, two brilliant doctors reunite by chance — each facing life’s worst slump and unexpectedly finding solace in each other.

1.title: FR - Docteur Slump [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: While Jeong-woo faces a mysterious attack, Ha-neul finds a crucial clue at his home. Jeong-woo encounters someone who may turn the tides of his trial.

1.title: FR - Docteur Slump [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: After holding hands with Jeong-woo, Ha-neul tries to decipher their relationship status — but her mental health begins to take a toll amid sudden news.

1.title: FR - Docteur Slump [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Jeong-woo and Ha-neul navigate life without each other after she pushes him away. Jeong-woo panics as he operates for the first time since his trial.

1.title: FR - Docteur Slump [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: As Jeong-woo struggles with his trauma, Ha-neul shows up to support him. But after he rejects her help, he discovers what made her break up with him.

1.title: FR - Docteur Slump [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: As their love blossoms, Ha-neul and Jeong-woo struggle to keep their relationship a secret. Lee Hong-ran bonds with Bin Dae-yeong during his time of need.

1.title: FR - Docteur Slump [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: While on a nostalgic getaway, Ha-neul and Jeong-woo are joined by Hong-ran and Dae-yeong. Ha-neul confronts Min Kyung-min about a potential foul play.

1.title: FR - Docteur Slump [VOSTFR] - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: Jeong-woo, alongside Ha-neul's family, awaits the outcome of her surgery. Later, he learns the full depth of Kyung-min's complicated motives.

1.title: FR - Docteur Slump [VOSTFR] - S01E14 - Episode 14
1.plot: Needing an escape, Jeong-woo takes a special trip to Busan with Ha-neul and her family. He later laments as Ha-neul's new job takes her away from him.

meta.plot: France, 1815. Jean Valjean, a common thief, is released from prison after having lived a hell in life for 19 years, but a small mistake puts the law again on his trail. Ruthless Inspector Javert pursues him thorough years, driven by a twisted sense of justice, while Valjean reforms himself, thrives and dedicates his life to good deeds. In 1832, while the revolution ravages the streets of Paris, Valjean and Javert cross their paths for the last time.

En 1993. Clara Garnier, 5 ans, est enlevée. Ses ravisseurs demandent contre sa libération une énorme somme d’argent. L’échange de la rançon se termine en bain de sang : la mère de Clara est tuée et l’enfant ne réapparaitra jamais. Vivante ou morte, le mystère s’installe, provoquant un traumatisme dans la région et dans sa famille, l’une des plus fortunées de la Côte d’Azur.  25 ans plus tard, Aurore Garnier, la sœur aînée de Clara est devenue officier de police. À l’occasion d’une enquête, elle découvre que Clara est toujours vivante mais vit sous une autre identité sans connaître ses origines. Aurore va tout mettre en œuvre pour que Clara retrouve sa famille. Mais ce retour inespéré va déclencher une série d’événements violents et faire remonter à la surface des secrets de famille que chacun pensait enfouis à jamais…

meta.plot: When a singer is found murdered, with her scent glands excised from her body, detectives probe a group of friends who attended boarding school with her.

1.title: FR - Le Nom de la rose - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Young Adso of Melk leaves the ranks of his father, a powerful warlord, and joins William of Baskerville, a Franciscan monk who heads to an abbey in northern Italy to participate in a theological debate.

1.title: FR - Le Nom de la rose - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: After another outrageous event occurs, William's investigation leads him and his apprentice Adso to the doors of the mysterious library, where everyone but the librarians are forbidden to enter. Meanwhile, the inquisitor Bernardo Gui, Pope John's ambassador, brings the wrath of his fanaticism to anyone who cross his path.

1.title: FR - Le Nom de la rose - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: While William asks for a magnifying glass to be able to proceed with his investigation, Adso meets the mysterious Occitan girl and huntress Anna pursues Bernardo Gui's entourage to avenge her family.

1.title: FR - Le Nom de la rose - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: After a new tragic event occurs, William and Adso increase their efforts to decipher the mysterious structure of the labyrinthine library, although Adso is more interested in spending time with the Occitan girl.

1.title: FR - Le Nom de la rose - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Anna is saved at the last minute. Bernardo Gui's armed entourage arrives at the abbey. After a copious feast, an insidious monk poisons his ears by reporting the presence inside the sacred walls of some former Dolcinian heretics.

1.title: FR - Le Nom de la rose - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Anna gets better. The Occitan girl gets into trouble. Meanwhile, the debate continues, but is interrupted by another tragic event.

1.title: FR - Le Nom de la rose - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Gui uses Salvatore to get to Remigio and put him on trial. William gives his thoughts on both the show trial and the poverty debate between the Franciscans and the Church. Anna tries to rescue her friends, and another mysterious death occurs.

1.title: FR - Le Nom de la rose - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: With the debate over, Gui condemns Remigio and the girl to be burnt at the stake. William and Adso try to solve the library's puzzle and catch the killer before it's too late, and Anna makes a final desperate move.

meta.plot: Northern Italy, 1327. The Franciscan monk William of Baskerville and his young apprentice Adso of Melk reach an isolated Benedictine abbey on the Alps to aid in a dispute between the Franciscan Order and the Avignon papacy. Upon arrival at the abbey, the two find themselves involved in a chain of mysterious deaths.

A veteran beat cop and teenage girl fall to their deaths from a tower block in south-east London, leaving a five-year-old boy and rookie police officer Lizzie Griffiths on the roof, only for them to go missing. Detective Sergeant Sarah Collins is drafted in to investigate, working to find Lizzie before she comes to serious harm, but also to uncover the truth behind the grisly tower block deaths.

1.title: FR - The Tower - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: DS Sarah Collins and her colleague, DC Steve Bradshaw, officers in the Directorate of Special Investigations (DSI), are called to an incident at Portland Tower in south east London. They find at the bottom of the tower the dead bodies of long-serving police officer, PC Hadley Matthews, and a 15-year-old Libyan refugee, Farah Mehenni.

1.title: FR - The Tower - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: With Lizzie still on the run, Sarah finally persuades her boss, DCI Tim Bailie, to go public about Lizzie's disappearance. Later, she makes a series of discoveries about the events that led up to the Portland Tower fall which further complicate the case.

1.title: FR - The Tower - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Lizzie decides to turn herself in, but first she meets Kieran Shaw in secret, who tries to persuade her not to implicate herself. When Sarah finally interviews Lizzie, the explosive truth about what really happened on top of the tower emerges

2.title: FR - The Tower - S02E02 - Episode 2

2.title: FR - The Tower - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: The Brannon manhunt reaches its climax, and Sarah faces Tania's killer.

meta.plot:
Epic drama set in the summer of 1932 where India dreams of independence, but the British are clinging to power. 

Set against the sweeping grandeur of the Himalayas and tea plantations of Northern India, the drama tells the rich and explosive story of the decline of the British Empire and the birth of modern India, from both sides of the experience. At the heart of the story lie the implications and ramifications of the tangled web of passions, rivalries and clashes that define the lives of those brought together in this summer which will change everything.
